## `lib/app_providers.dart`

```dart
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/locale_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/theme/theme_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/data/repositories/deck_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/logic/deck_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/data/repositories/profile_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/network_cubit.dart';
class AppProviders extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final AppDatabase database;
  final SharedPreferences prefs;
  const AppProviders({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.database,
    required this.prefs,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MultiRepositoryProvider(
      providers: [
        RepositoryProvider.value(value: database),
        RepositoryProvider.value(value: prefs),
        RepositoryProvider(create: (_) => AuthRepository()),
        RepositoryProvider(create: (_) => DeckRepository(database)),
        RepositoryProvider(create: (_) => CardRepository(database)),
        RepositoryProvider(
          create: (context) => ProfileRepository(
            context.read<AppDatabase>(),
            context.read<SharedPreferences>(),
          ),
        ),
        RepositoryProvider<ApiClient>(create: (_) => ApiClient()),
        RepositoryProvider(
          create: (context) => GameRepository(
            context.read<AppDatabase>(),
            context.read<ApiClient>(),
          ),
        ),
      ],
      child: MultiBlocProvider(
        providers: [
          BlocProvider(
            create: (context) =>
                AuthCubit(context.read<AuthRepository>(), database),
          ),
          BlocProvider(
            create: (context) => DeckCubit(context.read<DeckRepository>()),
          ),
          BlocProvider(create: (context) => NetworkCubit()),
          BlocProvider(create: (context) => ThemeCubit(prefs)),
          BlocProvider(create: (context) => LocaleCubit(prefs)),
          BlocProvider(
            create: (context) => ProfileCubit(
              context.read<ProfileRepository>(),
              FirebaseAuth.instance,
            ),
          ),
        ],
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/auth_gate.dart`

```dart
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart' as firebase_auth;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/locale_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/theme/theme_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/login_sreen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/register_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/welcome_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/home/presentation/screens/main_wrapper.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart';
class MyApp extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  _MyAppState createState() => _MyAppState();
}
class _MyAppState extends State<MyApp> {
  late final Stream<firebase_auth.User?> _authStateChanges;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _authStateChanges = firebase_auth.FirebaseAuth.instance.authStateChanges();
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.watch<LocaleCubit>().state;
    final themeMode = context.watch<ThemeCubit>().state;
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'MemoLingvo',
      locale: locale,
      themeMode: themeMode,
      theme: ThemeData.light(),
      darkTheme: ThemeData.dark(),
      localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ru')],
      initialRoute: '/',
      onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
        switch (settings.name) {
          case '/':
            return MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => _AuthGate(stream: _authStateChanges),
            );
          case '/login':
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => LoginScreen());
          case '/register':
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => RegisterScreen());
          case '/welcome':
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => WelcomeScreen());
          case '/home':
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => MainWrapper());
          default:
            return MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => Scaffold(body: Text('Unknown route')),
            );
        }
      },
    );
  }
}
class _AuthGate extends StatelessWidget {
  final Stream<firebase_auth.User?> stream;
  const _AuthGate({required this.stream});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<firebase_auth.User?>(
      stream: stream,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
          return SplashScreen();
        }
        if (snapshot.hasData) {
          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
            Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/home');
          });
          return Container();
        }
        return WelcomeScreen();
      },
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/database/app_database.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:drift/native.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
part 'app_database.g.dart';
enum LearningStatus { newCard, learning, mastered }
class StringListConverter extends TypeConverter<List<String>, String> {
  const StringListConverter();
  @override
  List<String> fromSql(String fromDb) =>
      (jsonDecode(fromDb) as List).cast<String>();
  @override
  String toSql(List<String> value) => jsonEncode(value);
}
class UsersTable extends Table {
  TextColumn get id => text()();
  TextColumn get email => text()();
  DateTimeColumn get createdAt => dateTime()();
  IntColumn get rank => integer().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
  IntColumn get experience => integer().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
  @override
  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {id};
}
class GameSessions extends Table {
  TextColumn get id => text()();
  TextColumn get userId => text().references(UsersTable, #id)();
  TextColumn get gameType => text()();
  TextColumn get result => text()();
  IntColumn get score => integer()();
  IntColumn get timeTakenSeconds => integer()();
  IntColumn get accuracyPercent => integer()();
  DateTimeColumn get playedAt => dateTime()();
  DateTimeColumn get updateAt => dateTime()();
  BoolColumn get isDirty => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  @override
  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {id};
}
class Decks extends Table {
  TextColumn get id => text()();
  TextColumn get userId => text().references(UsersTable, #id)();
  TextColumn get title => text().withLength(min: 1, max: 100)();
  TextColumn get description => text().nullable()();
  DateTimeColumn get updateAt => dateTime()();
  BoolColumn get isDeleted => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  BoolColumn get isDirty => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  @override
  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {id};
}
class Cards extends Table {
  TextColumn get id => text()();
  TextColumn get deckId =>
      text().references(Decks, #id, onDelete: KeyAction.cascade)();
  TextColumn get word => text()();
  TextColumn get translation => text()();
  TextColumn get transcription => text().nullable()();
  TextColumn get meaning => text()();
  TextColumn get examples =>
      text().map(const StringListConverter()).nullable()();
  DateTimeColumn get updateAt => dateTime()();
  BoolColumn get isDeleted => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  BoolColumn get isDirty => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  IntColumn get status =>
      intEnum<LearningStatus>().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
  @override
  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {id};
}
class CardProgress extends Table {
  TextColumn get cardId =>
      text().references(Cards, #id, onDelete: KeyAction.cascade)();
  TextColumn get userId => text().references(UsersTable, #id)();
  DateTimeColumn get nextReview => dateTime()();
  RealColumn get easinessFactor => real().withDefault(const Constant(2.5))();
  IntColumn get repetitions => integer().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
  IntColumn get interval => integer().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
  DateTimeColumn get updateAt => dateTime()();
  BoolColumn get isDirty => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
  @override
  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {cardId, userId};
}
class DeckWithCount {
  final Deck deck;
  final int cardCount;
  DeckWithCount(this.deck, this.cardCount);
}
@DriftDatabase(tables: [UsersTable, Decks, Cards, CardProgress, GameSessions])
class AppDatabase extends _$AppDatabase {
  AppDatabase() : super(_openConnection());
  @override
  int get schemaVersion => 2;
  @override
  MigrationStrategy get migration => MigrationStrategy(
    beforeOpen: (details) async {
      await customStatement('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    },
    onUpgrade: (m, from, to) async {
      if (from < 2) {
        await m.createTable(gameSessions);
        await m.addColumn(usersTable, usersTable.experience);
        await m.addColumn(usersTable, usersTable.rank);
      }
    },
  );
  Future<String?> getServerUserId(String email) async {
    final user = await (select(
      usersTable,
    )..where((t) => t.email.equals(email))).getSingleOrNull();
    return user?.id;
  }
  Stream<List<DeckWithCount>> watchDecksWithCardCount(String currentUserId) {
    final countColumn = cards.id.count();
    final query = select(
      decks,
    )..where((t) => t.isDeleted.equals(false) & t.userId.equals(currentUserId));
    final joinedQuery = query.join([
      leftOuterJoin(
        cards,
        cards.deckId.equalsExp(decks.id) & cards.isDeleted.equals(false),
      ),
    ]);
    joinedQuery.groupBy([decks.id]);
    joinedQuery.addColumns([countColumn]);
    return joinedQuery.watch().map((rows) {
      return rows.map((row) {
        return DeckWithCount(row.readTable(decks), row.read(countColumn) ?? 0);
      }).toList();
    });
  }
}
LazyDatabase _openConnection() {
  return LazyDatabase(() async {
    final dbFolder = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final file = File(p.join(dbFolder.path, 'db.sqlite'));
    return NativeDatabase.createInBackground(file);
  });
}
```

## `lib/core/database/app_database.g.dart`

```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
part of 'app_database.dart';
// ignore_for_file: type=lint
class $UsersTableTable extends UsersTable
    with TableInfo<$UsersTableTable, UsersTableData> {
  @override
  final GeneratedDatabase attachedDatabase;
  final String? _alias;
  $UsersTableTable(this.attachedDatabase, [this._alias]);
  static const VerificationMeta _idMeta = const VerificationMeta('id');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> id = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'id',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _emailMeta = const VerificationMeta('email');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> email = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'email',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _createdAtMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'createdAt',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<DateTime> createdAt = GeneratedColumn<DateTime>(
    'created_at',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.dateTime,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _rankMeta = const VerificationMeta('rank');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<int> rank = GeneratedColumn<int>(
    'rank',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.int,
    requiredDuringInsert: false,
    defaultValue: const Constant(0),
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _experienceMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'experience',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<int> experience = GeneratedColumn<int>(
    'experience',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.int,
    requiredDuringInsert: false,
    defaultValue: const Constant(0),
  );
  @override
  List<GeneratedColumn> get $columns => [
    id,
    email,
    createdAt,
    rank,
    experience,
  ];
  @override
  String get aliasedName => _alias ?? actualTableName;
  @override
  String get actualTableName => $name;
  static const String $name = 'users_table';
  @override
  VerificationContext validateIntegrity(
    Insertable<UsersTableData> instance, {
    bool isInserting = false,
  }) {
    final context = VerificationContext();
    final data = instance.toColumns(true);
    if (data.containsKey('id')) {
      context.handle(_idMeta, id.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['id']!, _idMeta));
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_idMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('email')) {
      context.handle(
        _emailMeta,
        email.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['email']!, _emailMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_emailMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('created_at')) {
      context.handle(
        _createdAtMeta,
        createdAt.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['created_at']!, _createdAtMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_createdAtMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('rank')) {
      context.handle(
        _rankMeta,
        rank.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['rank']!, _rankMeta),
      );
    }
    if (data.containsKey('experience')) {
      context.handle(
        _experienceMeta,
        experience.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['experience']!, _experienceMeta),
      );
    }
    return context;
  }
  @override
  Set<GeneratedColumn> get $primaryKey => {id};
  @override
  UsersTableData map(Map<String, dynamic> data, {String? tablePrefix}) {
    final effectivePrefix = tablePrefix != null ? '$tablePrefix.' : '';
    return UsersTableData(
      id: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}id'],
      )!,
      email: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}email'],
      )!,
      createdAt: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.dateTime,
        data['${effectivePrefix}created_at'],
      )!,
      rank: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.int,
        data['${effectivePrefix}rank'],
      )!,
      experience: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.int,
        data['${effectivePrefix}experience'],
      )!,
    );
  }
  @override
  $UsersTableTable createAlias(String alias) {
    return $UsersTableTable(attachedDatabase, alias);
  }
}

class UsersTableCompanion extends UpdateCompanion<UsersTableData> {

  final Value<int> experience;
  final Value<int> rowid;

    this.createdAt = const Value.absent(),
    this.rank = const Value.absent(),

    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  });

    required String id,
    required String email,

    this.rank = const Value.absent(),
    this.experience = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  }) : id = Value(id),
       email = Value(email),
       createdAt = Value(createdAt);
  static Insertable<UsersTableData> custom({
    Expression<String>? id,
    Expression<String>? email,
    Expression<DateTime>? createdAt,
    Expression<int>? rank,
    Expression<int>? experience,
    Expression<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return RawValuesInsertable({
      if (id != null) 'id': id,
      if (email != null) 'email': email,
      if (createdAt != null) 'created_at': createdAt,
      if (rank != null) 'rank': rank,
      if (experience != null) 'experience': experience,
      if (rowid != null) 'rowid': rowid,
    });
  }
  UsersTableCompanion copyWith({
    Value<String>? id,
    Value<String>? email,
    Value<DateTime>? createdAt,
    Value<int>? rank,
    Value<int>? experience,
    Value<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return UsersTableCompanion(

      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,

      experience: experience ?? this.experience,
      rowid: rowid ?? this.rowid,
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    if (id.present) {
      map['id'] = Variable<String>(id.value);
    }
    if (email.present) {
      map['email'] = Variable<String>(email.value);
    }
    if (createdAt.present) {
      map['created_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(createdAt.value);
    }
    if (rank.present) {
      map['rank'] = Variable<int>(rank.value);
    }
    if (experience.present) {
      map['experience'] = Variable<int>(experience.value);
    }
    if (rowid.present) {
      map['rowid'] = Variable<int>(rowid.value);
    }

class $DecksTable extends Decks with TableInfo<$DecksTable, Deck> {
  @override
  final GeneratedDatabase attachedDatabase;
  final String? _alias;
  $DecksTable(this.attachedDatabase, [this._alias]);
  static const VerificationMeta _idMeta = const VerificationMeta('id');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> id = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'id',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _userIdMeta = const VerificationMeta('userId');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> userId = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'user_id',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
    defaultConstraints: GeneratedColumn.constraintIsAlways(
      'REFERENCES users_table (id)',
    ),
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _titleMeta = const VerificationMeta('title');
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> title = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'title',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    additionalChecks: GeneratedColumn.checkTextLength(
      minTextLength: 1,
      maxTextLength: 100,
    ),
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _descriptionMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'description',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<String> description = GeneratedColumn<String>(
    'description',
    aliasedName,
    true,
    type: DriftSqlType.string,
    requiredDuringInsert: false,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _updateAtMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'updateAt',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<DateTime> updateAt = GeneratedColumn<DateTime>(
    'update_at',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.dateTime,
    requiredDuringInsert: true,
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _isDeletedMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'isDeleted',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<bool> isDeleted = GeneratedColumn<bool>(
    'is_deleted',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.bool,
    requiredDuringInsert: false,
    defaultConstraints: GeneratedColumn.constraintIsAlways(
      'CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1))',
    ),
    defaultValue: const Constant(false),
  );
  static const VerificationMeta _isDirtyMeta = const VerificationMeta(
    'isDirty',
  );
  @override
  late final GeneratedColumn<bool> isDirty = GeneratedColumn<bool>(
    'is_dirty',
    aliasedName,
    false,
    type: DriftSqlType.bool,
    requiredDuringInsert: false,
    defaultConstraints: GeneratedColumn.constraintIsAlways(
      'CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1))',
    ),
    defaultValue: const Constant(false),
  );
  @override
  List<GeneratedColumn> get $columns => [
    id,
    userId,
    title,
    description,
    updateAt,
    isDeleted,
    isDirty,
  ];
  @override
  String get aliasedName => _alias ?? actualTableName;
  @override
  String get actualTableName => $name;
  static const String $name = 'decks';
  @override
  VerificationContext validateIntegrity(
    Insertable<Deck> instance, {
    bool isInserting = false,
  }) {
    final context = VerificationContext();
    final data = instance.toColumns(true);
    if (data.containsKey('id')) {
      context.handle(_idMeta, id.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['id']!, _idMeta));
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_idMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('user_id')) {
      context.handle(
        _userIdMeta,
        userId.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['user_id']!, _userIdMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_userIdMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('title')) {
      context.handle(
        _titleMeta,
        title.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['title']!, _titleMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_titleMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('description')) {
      context.handle(
        _descriptionMeta,
        description.isAcceptableOrUnknown(
          data['description']!,
          _descriptionMeta,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (data.containsKey('update_at')) {
      context.handle(
        _updateAtMeta,
        updateAt.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['update_at']!, _updateAtMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_updateAtMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('is_deleted')) {
      context.handle(
        _isDeletedMeta,
        isDeleted.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['is_deleted']!, _isDeletedMeta),
      );
    }
    if (data.containsKey('is_dirty')) {
      context.handle(
        _isDirtyMeta,
        isDirty.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['is_dirty']!, _isDirtyMeta),
      );
    }
    return context;
  }
  @override
  Set<GeneratedColumn> get $primaryKey => {id};
  @override
  Deck map(Map<String, dynamic> data, {String? tablePrefix}) {
    final effectivePrefix = tablePrefix != null ? '$tablePrefix.' : '';
    return Deck(
      id: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}id'],
      )!,
      userId: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}user_id'],
      )!,
      title: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}title'],
      )!,
      description: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}description'],
      ),
      updateAt: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.dateTime,
        data['${effectivePrefix}update_at'],
      )!,
      isDeleted: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.bool,
        data['${effectivePrefix}is_deleted'],
      )!,
      isDirty: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.bool,
        data['${effectivePrefix}is_dirty'],
      )!,
    );
  }
  @override
  $DecksTable createAlias(String alias) {
    return $DecksTable(attachedDatabase, alias);
  }
}
class Deck extends DataClass implements Insertable<Deck> {
  final String id;
  final String userId;
  final String title;
  final String? description;
  final DateTime updateAt;
  final bool isDeleted;
  final bool isDirty;
  const Deck({
    required this.id,
    required this.userId,
    required this.title,
    this.description,
    required this.updateAt,
    required this.isDeleted,
    required this.isDirty,
  });
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    map['id'] = Variable<String>(id);
    map['user_id'] = Variable<String>(userId);
    map['title'] = Variable<String>(title);
    if (!nullToAbsent || description != null) {
      map['description'] = Variable<String>(description);
    }
    map['update_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(updateAt);
    map['is_deleted'] = Variable<bool>(isDeleted);
    map['is_dirty'] = Variable<bool>(isDirty);
    return map;
  }
  DecksCompanion toCompanion(bool nullToAbsent) {
    return DecksCompanion(
      id: Value(id),
      userId: Value(userId),
      title: Value(title),
      description: description == null && nullToAbsent
          ? const Value.absent()
          : Value(description),
      updateAt: Value(updateAt),
      isDeleted: Value(isDeleted),
      isDirty: Value(isDirty),
    );
  }
  factory Deck.fromJson(
    Map<String, dynamic> json, {
    ValueSerializer? serializer,
  }) {
    serializer ??= driftRuntimeOptions.defaultSerializer;
    return Deck(
      id: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['id']),
      userId: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['userId']),
      title: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['title']),
      description: serializer.fromJson<String?>(json['description']),
      updateAt: serializer.fromJson<DateTime>(json['updateAt']),
      isDeleted: serializer.fromJson<bool>(json['isDeleted']),
      isDirty: serializer.fromJson<bool>(json['isDirty']),
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson({ValueSerializer? serializer}) {
    serializer ??= driftRuntimeOptions.defaultSerializer;
    return <String, dynamic>{
      'id': serializer.toJson<String>(id),
      'userId': serializer.toJson<String>(userId),
      'title': serializer.toJson<String>(title),
      'description': serializer.toJson<String?>(description),
      'updateAt': serializer.toJson<DateTime>(updateAt),
      'isDeleted': serializer.toJson<bool>(isDeleted),
      'isDirty': serializer.toJson<bool>(isDirty),
    };
  }
  Deck copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? userId,
    String? title,
    Value<String?> description = const Value.absent(),
    DateTime? updateAt,
    bool? isDeleted,
    bool? isDirty,
  }) => Deck(
    id: id ?? this.id,
    userId: userId ?? this.userId,
    title: title ?? this.title,
    description: description.present ? description.value : this.description,
    updateAt: updateAt ?? this.updateAt,
    isDeleted: isDeleted ?? this.isDeleted,
    isDirty: isDirty ?? this.isDirty,
  );
  Deck copyWithCompanion(DecksCompanion data) {
    return Deck(
      id: data.id.present ? data.id.value : this.id,
      userId: data.userId.present ? data.userId.value : this.userId,
      title: data.title.present ? data.title.value : this.title,
      description: data.description.present
          ? data.description.value
          : this.description,
      updateAt: data.updateAt.present ? data.updateAt.value : this.updateAt,
      isDeleted: data.isDeleted.present ? data.isDeleted.value : this.isDeleted,
      isDirty: data.isDirty.present ? data.isDirty.value : this.isDirty,
    );
  }
  @override
  String toString() {
    return (StringBuffer('Deck(')
          ..write('id: $id, ')
          ..write('userId: $userId, ')
          ..write('title: $title, ')
          ..write('description: $description, ')
          ..write('updateAt: $updateAt, ')
          ..write('isDeleted: $isDeleted, ')
          ..write('isDirty: $isDirty')
          ..write(')'))
        .toString();
  }
  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      Object.hash(id, userId, title, description, updateAt, isDeleted, isDirty);
  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      (other is Deck &&
          other.id == this.id &&
          other.userId == this.userId &&
          other.title == this.title &&
          other.description == this.description &&
          other.updateAt == this.updateAt &&
          other.isDeleted == this.isDeleted &&
          other.isDirty == this.isDirty);
}

  );

        'status',
        aliasedName,

    id,

  @override
  VerificationContext validateIntegrity(
    Insertable<Card> instance, {
    bool isInserting = false,
  }) {
    final context = VerificationContext();
    final data = instance.toColumns(true);
    if (data.containsKey('id')) {
      context.handle(_idMeta, id.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['id']!, _idMeta));
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_idMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('deck_id')) {
      context.handle(
        _deckIdMeta,
        deckId.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['deck_id']!, _deckIdMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_deckIdMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('word')) {
      context.handle(
        _wordMeta,
        word.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['word']!, _wordMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_wordMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('translation')) {
      context.handle(
        _translationMeta,
        translation.isAcceptableOrUnknown(
          data['translation']!,
          _translationMeta,
        ),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_translationMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('transcription')) {
      context.handle(
        _transcriptionMeta,
        transcription.isAcceptableOrUnknown(
          data['transcription']!,
          _transcriptionMeta,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (data.containsKey('meaning')) {
      context.handle(
        _meaningMeta,
        meaning.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['meaning']!, _meaningMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_meaningMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('update_at')) {
      context.handle(
        _updateAtMeta,
        updateAt.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['update_at']!, _updateAtMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_updateAtMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('is_deleted')) {
      context.handle(
        _isDeletedMeta,
        isDeleted.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['is_deleted']!, _isDeletedMeta),
      );
    }
    if (data.containsKey('is_dirty')) {
      context.handle(
        _isDirtyMeta,
        isDirty.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['is_dirty']!, _isDirtyMeta),
      );
    }
    return context;
  }
  @override
  Set<GeneratedColumn> get $primaryKey => {id};
  @override
  Card map(Map<String, dynamic> data, {String? tablePrefix}) {
    final effectivePrefix = tablePrefix != null ? '$tablePrefix.' : '';
    return Card(
      id: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}id'],
      )!,
      deckId: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}deck_id'],
      )!,
      word: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}word'],
      )!,
      translation: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}translation'],
      )!,
      transcription: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}transcription'],
      ),
      meaning: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.string,
        data['${effectivePrefix}meaning'],
      )!,
      examples: $CardsTable.$converterexamplesn.fromSql(
        attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
          DriftSqlType.string,
          data['${effectivePrefix}examples'],
        ),
      ),
      updateAt: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.dateTime,
        data['${effectivePrefix}update_at'],
      )!,
      isDeleted: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.bool,
        data['${effectivePrefix}is_deleted'],
      )!,
      isDirty: attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
        DriftSqlType.bool,
        data['${effectivePrefix}is_dirty'],
      )!,
      status: $CardsTable.$converterstatus.fromSql(
        attachedDatabase.typeMapping.read(
          DriftSqlType.int,
          data['${effectivePrefix}status'],
        )!,
      ),
    );
  }
  @override
  $CardsTable createAlias(String alias) {
    return $CardsTable(attachedDatabase, alias);
  }
  static TypeConverter<List<String>, String> $converterexamples =
      const StringListConverter();
  static TypeConverter<List<String>?, String?> $converterexamplesn =
      NullAwareTypeConverter.wrap($converterexamples);
  static JsonTypeConverter2<LearningStatus, int, int> $converterstatus =
      const EnumIndexConverter<LearningStatus>(LearningStatus.values);
}
class Card extends DataClass implements Insertable<Card> {
  final String id;
  final String deckId;
  final String word;
  final String translation;
  final String? transcription;
  final String meaning;
  final List<String>? examples;
  final DateTime updateAt;
  final bool isDeleted;
  final bool isDirty;
  final LearningStatus status;
  const Card({
    required this.id,
    required this.deckId,
    required this.word,
    required this.translation,
    this.transcription,
    required this.meaning,
    this.examples,
    required this.updateAt,
    required this.isDeleted,
    required this.isDirty,
    required this.status,
  });
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    map['id'] = Variable<String>(id);
    map['deck_id'] = Variable<String>(deckId);
    map['word'] = Variable<String>(word);
    map['translation'] = Variable<String>(translation);
    if (!nullToAbsent || transcription != null) {
      map['transcription'] = Variable<String>(transcription);
    }
    map['meaning'] = Variable<String>(meaning);
    if (!nullToAbsent || examples != null) {
      map['examples'] = Variable<String>(
        $CardsTable.$converterexamplesn.toSql(examples),
      );
    }
    map['update_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(updateAt);
    map['is_deleted'] = Variable<bool>(isDeleted);
    map['is_dirty'] = Variable<bool>(isDirty);
    {
      map['status'] = Variable<int>($CardsTable.$converterstatus.toSql(status));
    }
    return map;
  }
  CardsCompanion toCompanion(bool nullToAbsent) {
    return CardsCompanion(
      id: Value(id),
      deckId: Value(deckId),
      word: Value(word),
      translation: Value(translation),
      transcription: transcription == null && nullToAbsent
          ? const Value.absent()
          : Value(transcription),
      meaning: Value(meaning),
      examples: examples == null && nullToAbsent
          ? const Value.absent()
          : Value(examples),
      updateAt: Value(updateAt),
      isDeleted: Value(isDeleted),
      isDirty: Value(isDirty),
      status: Value(status),
    );
  }
  factory Card.fromJson(
    Map<String, dynamic> json, {
    ValueSerializer? serializer,
  }) {
    serializer ??= driftRuntimeOptions.defaultSerializer;
    return Card(
      id: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['id']),
      deckId: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['deckId']),
      word: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['word']),
      translation: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['translation']),
      transcription: serializer.fromJson<String?>(json['transcription']),
      meaning: serializer.fromJson<String>(json['meaning']),
      examples: serializer.fromJson<List<String>?>(json['examples']),
      updateAt: serializer.fromJson<DateTime>(json['updateAt']),
      isDeleted: serializer.fromJson<bool>(json['isDeleted']),
      isDirty: serializer.fromJson<bool>(json['isDirty']),
      status: $CardsTable.$converterstatus.fromJson(
        serializer.fromJson<int>(json['status']),
      ),
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson({ValueSerializer? serializer}) {
    serializer ??= driftRuntimeOptions.defaultSerializer;
    return <String, dynamic>{
      'id': serializer.toJson<String>(id),
      'deckId': serializer.toJson<String>(deckId),
      'word': serializer.toJson<String>(word),
      'translation': serializer.toJson<String>(translation),
      'transcription': serializer.toJson<String?>(transcription),
      'meaning': serializer.toJson<String>(meaning),
      'examples': serializer.toJson<List<String>?>(examples),
      'updateAt': serializer.toJson<DateTime>(updateAt),
      'isDeleted': serializer.toJson<bool>(isDeleted),
      'isDirty': serializer.toJson<bool>(isDirty),
      'status': serializer.toJson<int>(
        $CardsTable.$converterstatus.toJson(status),
      ),
    };
  }
  Card copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? deckId,
    String? word,
    String? translation,
    Value<String?> transcription = const Value.absent(),
    String? meaning,
    Value<List<String>?> examples = const Value.absent(),
    DateTime? updateAt,
    bool? isDeleted,
    bool? isDirty,
    LearningStatus? status,
  }) => Card(
    id: id ?? this.id,
    deckId: deckId ?? this.deckId,
    word: word ?? this.word,
    translation: translation ?? this.translation,
    transcription: transcription.present
        ? transcription.value
        : this.transcription,
    meaning: meaning ?? this.meaning,
    examples: examples.present ? examples.value : this.examples,
    updateAt: updateAt ?? this.updateAt,
    isDeleted: isDeleted ?? this.isDeleted,
    isDirty: isDirty ?? this.isDirty,
    status: status ?? this.status,
  );
  Card copyWithCompanion(CardsCompanion data) {
    return Card(
      id: data.id.present ? data.id.value : this.id,
      deckId: data.deckId.present ? data.deckId.value : this.deckId,
      word: data.word.present ? data.word.value : this.word,
      translation: data.translation.present
          ? data.translation.value
          : this.translation,
      transcription: data.transcription.present
          ? data.transcription.value
          : this.transcription,
      meaning: data.meaning.present ? data.meaning.value : this.meaning,
      examples: data.examples.present ? data.examples.value : this.examples,
      updateAt: data.updateAt.present ? data.updateAt.value : this.updateAt,
      isDeleted: data.isDeleted.present ? data.isDeleted.value : this.isDeleted,
      isDirty: data.isDirty.present ? data.isDirty.value : this.isDirty,
      status: data.status.present ? data.status.value : this.status,
    );
  }
  @override
  String toString() {
    return (StringBuffer('Card(')
          ..write('id: $id, ')
          ..write('deckId: $deckId, ')
          ..write('word: $word, ')
          ..write('translation: $translation, ')
          ..write('transcription: $transcription, ')
          ..write('meaning: $meaning, ')
          ..write('examples: $examples, ')
          ..write('updateAt: $updateAt, ')
          ..write('isDeleted: $isDeleted, ')
          ..write('isDirty: $isDirty, ')
          ..write('status: $status')
          ..write(')'))
        .toString();
  }
  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
    id,
    deckId,
    word,
    translation,
    transcription,
    meaning,
    examples,
    updateAt,
    isDeleted,
    isDirty,
    status,
  );
  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      (other is Card &&
          other.id == this.id &&
          other.deckId == this.deckId &&
          other.word == this.word &&
          other.translation == this.translation &&
          other.transcription == this.transcription &&
          other.meaning == this.meaning &&
          other.examples == this.examples &&
          other.updateAt == this.updateAt &&
          other.isDeleted == this.isDeleted &&
          other.isDirty == this.isDirty &&
          other.status == this.status);
}
class CardsCompanion extends UpdateCompanion<Card> {
  final Value<String> id;
  final Value<String> deckId;
  final Value<String> word;
  final Value<String> translation;
  final Value<String?> transcription;
  final Value<String> meaning;
  final Value<List<String>?> examples;
  final Value<DateTime> updateAt;
  final Value<bool> isDeleted;
  final Value<bool> isDirty;
  final Value<LearningStatus> status;
  final Value<int> rowid;
  const CardsCompanion({
    this.id = const Value.absent(),
    this.deckId = const Value.absent(),
    this.word = const Value.absent(),
    this.translation = const Value.absent(),
    this.transcription = const Value.absent(),
    this.meaning = const Value.absent(),
    this.examples = const Value.absent(),
    this.updateAt = const Value.absent(),
    this.isDeleted = const Value.absent(),
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.status = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  });
  CardsCompanion.insert({
    required String id,
    required String deckId,
    required String word,
    required String translation,
    this.transcription = const Value.absent(),
    required String meaning,
    this.examples = const Value.absent(),
    required DateTime updateAt,
    this.isDeleted = const Value.absent(),
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.status = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  }) : id = Value(id),
       deckId = Value(deckId),
       word = Value(word),
       translation = Value(translation),
       meaning = Value(meaning),
       updateAt = Value(updateAt);
  static Insertable<Card> custom({
    Expression<String>? id,
    Expression<String>? deckId,
    Expression<String>? word,
    Expression<String>? translation,
    Expression<String>? transcription,
    Expression<String>? meaning,
    Expression<String>? examples,
    Expression<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Expression<bool>? isDeleted,
    Expression<bool>? isDirty,
    Expression<int>? status,
    Expression<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return RawValuesInsertable({
      if (id != null) 'id': id,
      if (deckId != null) 'deck_id': deckId,
      if (word != null) 'word': word,
      if (translation != null) 'translation': translation,
      if (transcription != null) 'transcription': transcription,
      if (meaning != null) 'meaning': meaning,
      if (examples != null) 'examples': examples,
      if (updateAt != null) 'update_at': updateAt,
      if (isDeleted != null) 'is_deleted': isDeleted,
      if (isDirty != null) 'is_dirty': isDirty,
      if (status != null) 'status': status,
      if (rowid != null) 'rowid': rowid,
    });
  }
  CardsCompanion copyWith({
    Value<String>? id,
    Value<String>? deckId,
    Value<String>? word,
    Value<String>? translation,
    Value<String?>? transcription,
    Value<String>? meaning,
    Value<List<String>?>? examples,
    Value<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Value<bool>? isDeleted,
    Value<bool>? isDirty,
    Value<LearningStatus>? status,
    Value<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return CardsCompanion(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      deckId: deckId ?? this.deckId,
      word: word ?? this.word,
      translation: translation ?? this.translation,
      transcription: transcription ?? this.transcription,
      meaning: meaning ?? this.meaning,
      examples: examples ?? this.examples,
      updateAt: updateAt ?? this.updateAt,
      isDeleted: isDeleted ?? this.isDeleted,
      isDirty: isDirty ?? this.isDirty,
      status: status ?? this.status,
      rowid: rowid ?? this.rowid,
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    if (id.present) {
      map['id'] = Variable<String>(id.value);
    }
    if (deckId.present) {
      map['deck_id'] = Variable<String>(deckId.value);
    }
    if (word.present) {
      map['word'] = Variable<String>(word.value);
    }
    if (translation.present) {
      map['translation'] = Variable<String>(translation.value);
    }
    if (transcription.present) {
      map['transcription'] = Variable<String>(transcription.value);
    }
    if (meaning.present) {
      map['meaning'] = Variable<String>(meaning.value);
    }
    if (examples.present) {
      map['examples'] = Variable<String>(
        $CardsTable.$converterexamplesn.toSql(examples.value),
      );
    }
    if (updateAt.present) {
      map['update_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(updateAt.value);
    }
    if (isDeleted.present) {
      map['is_deleted'] = Variable<bool>(isDeleted.value);
    }
    if (isDirty.present) {
      map['is_dirty'] = Variable<bool>(isDirty.value);
    }
    if (status.present) {
      map['status'] = Variable<int>(
        $CardsTable.$converterstatus.toSql(status.value),
      );
    }
    if (rowid.present) {
      map['rowid'] = Variable<int>(rowid.value);
    }
    return map;
  }
  @override
  String toString() {
    return (StringBuffer('CardsCompanion(')
          ..write('id: $id, ')
          ..write('deckId: $deckId, ')
          ..write('word: $word, ')
          ..write('translation: $translation, ')
          ..write('transcription: $transcription, ')
          ..write('meaning: $meaning, ')
          ..write('examples: $examples, ')
          ..write('updateAt: $updateAt, ')
          ..write('isDeleted: $isDeleted, ')
          ..write('isDirty: $isDirty, ')
          ..write('status: $status, ')
          ..write('rowid: $rowid')
          ..write(')'))
        .toString();
  }
}

      )!,

class CardProgressCompanion extends UpdateCompanion<CardProgressData> {
  final Value<String> cardId;
  final Value<String> userId;
  final Value<DateTime> nextReview;
  final Value<double> easinessFactor;
  final Value<int> repetitions;
  final Value<int> interval;
  final Value<DateTime> updateAt;
  final Value<bool> isDirty;
  final Value<int> rowid;
  const CardProgressCompanion({
    this.cardId = const Value.absent(),
    this.userId = const Value.absent(),
    this.nextReview = const Value.absent(),
    this.easinessFactor = const Value.absent(),
    this.repetitions = const Value.absent(),
    this.interval = const Value.absent(),
    this.updateAt = const Value.absent(),
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  });
  CardProgressCompanion.insert({
    required String cardId,
    required String userId,
    required DateTime nextReview,
    this.easinessFactor = const Value.absent(),
    this.repetitions = const Value.absent(),
    this.interval = const Value.absent(),
    required DateTime updateAt,
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  }) : cardId = Value(cardId),
       userId = Value(userId),
       nextReview = Value(nextReview),
       updateAt = Value(updateAt);
  static Insertable<CardProgressData> custom({
    Expression<String>? cardId,
    Expression<String>? userId,
    Expression<DateTime>? nextReview,
    Expression<double>? easinessFactor,
    Expression<int>? repetitions,
    Expression<int>? interval,
    Expression<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Expression<bool>? isDirty,
    Expression<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return RawValuesInsertable({
      if (cardId != null) 'card_id': cardId,
      if (userId != null) 'user_id': userId,
      if (nextReview != null) 'next_review': nextReview,
      if (easinessFactor != null) 'easiness_factor': easinessFactor,
      if (repetitions != null) 'repetitions': repetitions,
      if (interval != null) 'interval': interval,
      if (updateAt != null) 'update_at': updateAt,
      if (isDirty != null) 'is_dirty': isDirty,
      if (rowid != null) 'rowid': rowid,
    });
  }
  CardProgressCompanion copyWith({
    Value<String>? cardId,
    Value<String>? userId,
    Value<DateTime>? nextReview,
    Value<double>? easinessFactor,
    Value<int>? repetitions,
    Value<int>? interval,
    Value<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Value<bool>? isDirty,
    Value<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return CardProgressCompanion(
      cardId: cardId ?? this.cardId,
      userId: userId ?? this.userId,
      nextReview: nextReview ?? this.nextReview,
      easinessFactor: easinessFactor ?? this.easinessFactor,
      repetitions: repetitions ?? this.repetitions,
      interval: interval ?? this.interval,
      updateAt: updateAt ?? this.updateAt,
      isDirty: isDirty ?? this.isDirty,
      rowid: rowid ?? this.rowid,
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    if (cardId.present) {
      map['card_id'] = Variable<String>(cardId.value);
    }
    if (userId.present) {
      map['user_id'] = Variable<String>(userId.value);
    }
    if (nextReview.present) {
      map['next_review'] = Variable<DateTime>(nextReview.value);
    }
    if (easinessFactor.present) {
      map['easiness_factor'] = Variable<double>(easinessFactor.value);
    }
    if (repetitions.present) {
      map['repetitions'] = Variable<int>(repetitions.value);
    }
    if (interval.present) {
      map['interval'] = Variable<int>(interval.value);
    }
    if (updateAt.present) {
      map['update_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(updateAt.value);
    }
    if (isDirty.present) {
      map['is_dirty'] = Variable<bool>(isDirty.value);
    }
    if (rowid.present) {
      map['rowid'] = Variable<int>(rowid.value);
    }
    return map;
  }
  @override
  String toString() {
    return (StringBuffer('CardProgressCompanion(')
          ..write('cardId: $cardId, ')
          ..write('userId: $userId, ')
          ..write('nextReview: $nextReview, ')
          ..write('easinessFactor: $easinessFactor, ')
          ..write('repetitions: $repetitions, ')
          ..write('interval: $interval, ')
          ..write('updateAt: $updateAt, ')
          ..write('isDirty: $isDirty, ')
          ..write('rowid: $rowid')
          ..write(')'))
        .toString();
  }

    Insertable<GameSession> instance, {
    bool isInserting = false,
  }) {
    final context = VerificationContext();
    final data = instance.toColumns(true);
    if (data.containsKey('id')) {
      context.handle(_idMeta, id.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['id']!, _idMeta));
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_idMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('user_id')) {

      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_resultMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('score')) {
      context.handle(
        _scoreMeta,
        score.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['score']!, _scoreMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_scoreMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('time_taken_seconds')) {
      context.handle(
        _timeTakenSecondsMeta,
        timeTakenSeconds.isAcceptableOrUnknown(
          data['time_taken_seconds']!,
          _timeTakenSecondsMeta,
        ),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_timeTakenSecondsMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('accuracy_percent')) {
      context.handle(
        _accuracyPercentMeta,
        accuracyPercent.isAcceptableOrUnknown(
          data['accuracy_percent']!,
          _accuracyPercentMeta,
        ),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_accuracyPercentMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('played_at')) {
      context.handle(
        _playedAtMeta,
        playedAt.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['played_at']!, _playedAtMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {
      context.missing(_playedAtMeta);
    }
    if (data.containsKey('update_at')) {
      context.handle(
        _updateAtMeta,
        updateAt.isAcceptableOrUnknown(data['update_at']!, _updateAtMeta),
      );
    } else if (isInserting) {

    }

    }

          other.isDirty == this.isDirty);
}
class GameSessionsCompanion extends UpdateCompanion<GameSession> {
  final Value<String> id;
  final Value<String> userId;
  final Value<String> gameType;
  final Value<String> result;
  final Value<int> score;
  final Value<int> timeTakenSeconds;
  final Value<int> accuracyPercent;
  final Value<DateTime> playedAt;
  final Value<DateTime> updateAt;
  final Value<bool> isDirty;
  final Value<int> rowid;
  const GameSessionsCompanion({
    this.id = const Value.absent(),
    this.userId = const Value.absent(),
    this.gameType = const Value.absent(),
    this.result = const Value.absent(),
    this.score = const Value.absent(),
    this.timeTakenSeconds = const Value.absent(),
    this.accuracyPercent = const Value.absent(),
    this.playedAt = const Value.absent(),
    this.updateAt = const Value.absent(),
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  });
  GameSessionsCompanion.insert({
    required String id,
    required String userId,
    required String gameType,
    required String result,
    required int score,
    required int timeTakenSeconds,
    required int accuracyPercent,
    required DateTime playedAt,
    required DateTime updateAt,
    this.isDirty = const Value.absent(),
    this.rowid = const Value.absent(),
  }) : id = Value(id),
       userId = Value(userId),
       gameType = Value(gameType),
       result = Value(result),
       score = Value(score),
       timeTakenSeconds = Value(timeTakenSeconds),
       accuracyPercent = Value(accuracyPercent),
       playedAt = Value(playedAt),
       updateAt = Value(updateAt);
  static Insertable<GameSession> custom({
    Expression<String>? id,
    Expression<String>? userId,
    Expression<String>? gameType,
    Expression<String>? result,
    Expression<int>? score,
    Expression<int>? timeTakenSeconds,
    Expression<int>? accuracyPercent,
    Expression<DateTime>? playedAt,
    Expression<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Expression<bool>? isDirty,
    Expression<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return RawValuesInsertable({
      if (id != null) 'id': id,
      if (userId != null) 'user_id': userId,
      if (gameType != null) 'game_type': gameType,
      if (result != null) 'result': result,
      if (score != null) 'score': score,
      if (timeTakenSeconds != null) 'time_taken_seconds': timeTakenSeconds,
      if (accuracyPercent != null) 'accuracy_percent': accuracyPercent,
      if (playedAt != null) 'played_at': playedAt,
      if (updateAt != null) 'update_at': updateAt,
      if (isDirty != null) 'is_dirty': isDirty,
      if (rowid != null) 'rowid': rowid,
    });
  }
  GameSessionsCompanion copyWith({
    Value<String>? id,
    Value<String>? userId,
    Value<String>? gameType,
    Value<String>? result,
    Value<int>? score,
    Value<int>? timeTakenSeconds,
    Value<int>? accuracyPercent,
    Value<DateTime>? playedAt,
    Value<DateTime>? updateAt,
    Value<bool>? isDirty,
    Value<int>? rowid,
  }) {
    return GameSessionsCompanion(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      userId: userId ?? this.userId,
      gameType: gameType ?? this.gameType,
      result: result ?? this.result,
      score: score ?? this.score,
      timeTakenSeconds: timeTakenSeconds ?? this.timeTakenSeconds,
      accuracyPercent: accuracyPercent ?? this.accuracyPercent,
      playedAt: playedAt ?? this.playedAt,
      updateAt: updateAt ?? this.updateAt,
      isDirty: isDirty ?? this.isDirty,
      rowid: rowid ?? this.rowid,
    );
  }
  @override
  Map<String, Expression> toColumns(bool nullToAbsent) {
    final map = <String, Expression>{};
    if (id.present) {
      map['id'] = Variable<String>(id.value);
    }
    if (userId.present) {
      map['user_id'] = Variable<String>(userId.value);
    }
    if (gameType.present) {
      map['game_type'] = Variable<String>(gameType.value);
    }
    if (result.present) {
      map['result'] = Variable<String>(result.value);
    }
    if (score.present) {
      map['score'] = Variable<int>(score.value);
    }
    if (timeTakenSeconds.present) {
      map['time_taken_seconds'] = Variable<int>(timeTakenSeconds.value);
    }
    if (accuracyPercent.present) {
      map['accuracy_percent'] = Variable<int>(accuracyPercent.value);
    }
    if (playedAt.present) {
      map['played_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(playedAt.value);
    }
    if (updateAt.present) {
      map['update_at'] = Variable<DateTime>(updateAt.value);
    }
    if (isDirty.present) {
      map['is_dirty'] = Variable<bool>(isDirty.value);
    }
    if (rowid.present) {
      map['rowid'] = Variable<int>(rowid.value);
    }
    return map;
  }

  String toString() {
    return (StringBuffer('GameSessionsCompanion(')
          ..write('id: $id, ')
          ..write('userId: $userId, ')
          ..write('gameType: $gameType, ')
          ..write('result: $result, ')
          ..write('score: $score, ')
          ..write('timeTakenSeconds: $timeTakenSeconds, ')
          ..write('accuracyPercent: $accuracyPercent, ')
          ..write('playedAt: $playedAt, ')
          ..write('updateAt: $updateAt, ')
          ..write('isDirty: $isDirty, ')
          ..write('rowid: $rowid')
          ..write(')'))
        .toString();
  }

class $$DecksTableTableManager
    extends
        RootTableManager<
          _$AppDatabase,
          $DecksTable,
          Deck,
          $$DecksTableFilterComposer,
          $$DecksTableOrderingComposer,
          $$DecksTableAnnotationComposer,
          $$DecksTableCreateCompanionBuilder,
          $$DecksTableUpdateCompanionBuilder,
          (Deck, $$DecksTableReferences),
          Deck,
          PrefetchHooks Function({bool userId, bool cardsRefs})
        > {
  $$DecksTableTableManager(_$AppDatabase db, $DecksTable table)
    : super(
        TableManagerState(
          db: db,
          table: table,
          createFilteringComposer: () =>
              $$DecksTableFilterComposer($db: db, $table: table),
          createOrderingComposer: () =>
              $$DecksTableOrderingComposer($db: db, $table: table),
          createComputedFieldComposer: () =>
              $$DecksTableAnnotationComposer($db: db, $table: table),
          updateCompanionCallback:
              ({
                Value<String> id = const Value.absent(),
                Value<String> userId = const Value.absent(),
                Value<String> title = const Value.absent(),
                Value<String?> description = const Value.absent(),
                Value<DateTime> updateAt = const Value.absent(),
                Value<bool> isDeleted = const Value.absent(),
                Value<bool> isDirty = const Value.absent(),
                Value<int> rowid = const Value.absent(),
              }) => DecksCompanion(
                id: id,
                userId: userId,
                title: title,
                description: description,
                updateAt: updateAt,
                isDeleted: isDeleted,
                isDirty: isDirty,
                rowid: rowid,
              ),
          createCompanionCallback:
              ({
                required String id,
                required String userId,
                required String title,
                Value<String?> description = const Value.absent(),
                required DateTime updateAt,
                Value<bool> isDeleted = const Value.absent(),
                Value<bool> isDirty = const Value.absent(),
                Value<int> rowid = const Value.absent(),
              }) => DecksCompanion.insert(
                id: id,
                userId: userId,
                title: title,
                description: description,
                updateAt: updateAt,
                isDeleted: isDeleted,
                isDirty: isDirty,
                rowid: rowid,
              ),
          withReferenceMapper: (p0) => p0
              .map(
                (e) =>
                    (e.readTable(table), $$DecksTableReferences(db, table, e)),
              )
              .toList(),
          prefetchHooksCallback: ({userId = false, cardsRefs = false}) {
            return PrefetchHooks(
              db: db,
              explicitlyWatchedTables: [if (cardsRefs) db.cards],
              addJoins:
                  <
                    T extends TableManagerState<
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic
                    >
                  >(state) {
                    if (userId) {
                      state =
                          state.withJoin(
                                currentTable: table,
                                currentColumn: table.userId,
                                referencedTable: $$DecksTableReferences
                                    ._userIdTable(db),
                                referencedColumn: $$DecksTableReferences
                                    ._userIdTable(db)
                                    .id,
                              )
                              as T;
                    }
                    return state;
                  },
              getPrefetchedDataCallback: (items) async {
                return [
                  if (cardsRefs)
                    await $_getPrefetchedData<Deck, $DecksTable, Card>(
                      currentTable: table,
                      referencedTable: $$DecksTableReferences._cardsRefsTable(
                        db,
                      ),
                      managerFromTypedResult: (p0) =>
                          $$DecksTableReferences(db, table, p0).cardsRefs,
                      referencedItemsForCurrentItem: (item, referencedItems) =>
                          referencedItems.where((e) => e.deckId == item.id),
                      typedResults: items,
                    ),
                ];
              },
            );
          },
        ),
      );
}

final class $$CardsTableReferences
    extends BaseReferences<_$AppDatabase, $CardsTable, Card> {
  $$CardsTableReferences(super.$_db, super.$_table, super.$_typedResult);
  static $DecksTable _deckIdTable(_$AppDatabase db) =>
      db.decks.createAlias('cards__deck_id__decks__id');
  $$DecksTableProcessedTableManager get deckId {
    final $_column = $_itemColumn<String>('deck_id')!;
    final manager = $$DecksTableTableManager(
      $_db,
      $_db.decks,
    ).filter((f) => f.id.sqlEquals($_column));
    final item = $_typedResult.readTableOrNull(_deckIdTable($_db));
    if (item == null) return manager;
    return ProcessedTableManager(
      manager.$state.copyWith(prefetchedData: [item]),
    );
  }
  static MultiTypedResultKey<$CardProgressTable, List<CardProgressData>>
  _cardProgressRefsTable(_$AppDatabase db) => MultiTypedResultKey.fromTable(
    db.cardProgress,
    aliasName: 'cards__id__card_progress__card_id',
  );
  $$CardProgressTableProcessedTableManager get cardProgressRefs {
    final manager = $$CardProgressTableTableManager(
      $_db,
      $_db.cardProgress,
    ).filter((f) => f.cardId.id.sqlEquals($_itemColumn<String>('id')!));
    final cache = $_typedResult.readTableOrNull(_cardProgressRefsTable($_db));
    return ProcessedTableManager(
      manager.$state.copyWith(prefetchedData: cache),
    );
  }
}

                    }
                    return state;
                  },
              getPrefetchedDataCallback: (items) async {
                return [
                  if (cardProgressRefs)
                    await $_getPrefetchedData<
                      Card,
                      $CardsTable,
                      CardProgressData
                    >(
                      currentTable: table,
                      referencedTable: $$CardsTableReferences
                          ._cardProgressRefsTable(db),
                      managerFromTypedResult: (p0) => $$CardsTableReferences(
                        db,
                        table,
                        p0,
                      ).cardProgressRefs,
                      referencedItemsForCurrentItem: (item, referencedItems) =>
                          referencedItems.where((e) => e.cardId == item.id),
                      typedResults: items,
                    ),
                ];
              },
            );
          },
        ),
      );
}

                accuracyPercent: accuracyPercent,
                playedAt: playedAt,
                updateAt: updateAt,
                isDirty: isDirty,
                rowid: rowid,
              ),
          createCompanionCallback:
              ({
                required String id,
                required String userId,
                required String gameType,
                required String result,
                required int score,
                required int timeTakenSeconds,
                required int accuracyPercent,
                required DateTime playedAt,
                required DateTime updateAt,
                Value<bool> isDirty = const Value.absent(),
                Value<int> rowid = const Value.absent(),
              }) => GameSessionsCompanion.insert(
                id: id,
                userId: userId,
                gameType: gameType,
                result: result,
                score: score,
                timeTakenSeconds: timeTakenSeconds,
                accuracyPercent: accuracyPercent,
                playedAt: playedAt,
                updateAt: updateAt,
                isDirty: isDirty,
                rowid: rowid,
              ),
          withReferenceMapper: (p0) => p0
              .map(
                (e) => (
                  e.readTable(table),
                  $$GameSessionsTableReferences(db, table, e),
                ),
              )
              .toList(),
          prefetchHooksCallback: ({userId = false}) {
            return PrefetchHooks(
              db: db,
              explicitlyWatchedTables: [],
              addJoins:
                  <
                    T extends TableManagerState<
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic,
                      dynamic
                    >
                  >(state) {
                    if (userId) {
                      state =
                          state.withJoin(
                                currentTable: table,
                                currentColumn: table.userId,
                                referencedTable: $$GameSessionsTableReferences
                                    ._userIdTable(db),
                                referencedColumn: $$GameSessionsTableReferences
                                    ._userIdTable(db)
                                    .id,
                              )
                              as T;
                    }
                    return state;
                  },
              getPrefetchedDataCallback: (items) async {
                return [];
              },
            );
          },
        ),
      );
}
typedef $$GameSessionsTableProcessedTableManager =
    ProcessedTableManager<
      _$AppDatabase,
      $GameSessionsTable,
      GameSession,
      $$GameSessionsTableFilterComposer,
      $$GameSessionsTableOrderingComposer,
      $$GameSessionsTableAnnotationComposer,
      $$GameSessionsTableCreateCompanionBuilder,
      $$GameSessionsTableUpdateCompanionBuilder,
      (GameSession, $$GameSessionsTableReferences),
      GameSession,
      PrefetchHooks Function({bool userId})
    >;
class $AppDatabaseManager {
  final _$AppDatabase _db;
  $AppDatabaseManager(this._db);
  $$UsersTableTableTableManager get usersTable =>
      $$UsersTableTableTableManager(_db, _db.usersTable);
  $$DecksTableTableManager get decks =>
      $$DecksTableTableManager(_db, _db.decks);
  $$CardsTableTableManager get cards =>
      $$CardsTableTableManager(_db, _db.cards);
  $$CardProgressTableTableManager get cardProgress =>
      $$CardProgressTableTableManager(_db, _db.cardProgress);
  $$GameSessionsTableTableManager get gameSessions =>
      $$GameSessionsTableTableManager(_db, _db.gameSessions);
}

## `lib/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart' as intl;
import 'app_localizations_en.dart';
import 'app_localizations_ru.dart';
// ignore_for_file: type=lint
/// Callers can lookup localized strings with an instance of AppLocalizations
/// returned by `AppLocalizations.of(context)`.
///
/// Applications need to include `AppLocalizations.delegate()` in their app's
/// `localizationDelegates` list, and the locales they support in the app's
/// `supportedLocales` list. For example:
///
/// ```dart
/// import 'l10n/app_localizations.dart';
///
/// return MaterialApp(
///   localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
///   supportedLocales: AppLocalizations.supportedLocales,
///   home: MyApplicationHome(),
/// );
/// ```
///
/// ## Update pubspec.yaml
///
/// Please make sure to update your pubspec.yaml to include the following
/// packages:
///
/// ```yaml
/// dependencies:
///   # Internationalization support.
///   flutter_localizations:
///     sdk: flutter
///   intl: any # Use the pinned version from flutter_localizations
///
///   # Rest of dependencies
/// ```
///
/// ## iOS Applications
///
/// iOS applications define key application metadata, including supported
/// locales, in an Info.plist file that is built into the application bundle.
/// To configure the locales supported by your app, you’ll need to edit this
/// file.
///
/// First, open your project’s ios/Runner.xcworkspace Xcode workspace file.
/// Then, in the Project Navigator, open the Info.plist file under the Runner
/// project’s Runner folder.
///
/// Next, select the Information Property List item, select Add Item from the
/// Editor menu, then select Localizations from the pop-up menu.
///
/// Select and expand the newly-created Localizations item then, for each
/// locale your application supports, add a new item and select the locale
/// you wish to add from the pop-up menu in the Value field. This list should
/// be consistent with the languages listed in the AppLocalizations.supportedLocales
/// property.
abstract class AppLocalizations {
  AppLocalizations(String locale)
    : localeName = intl.Intl.canonicalizedLocale(locale.toString());
  final String localeName;
  static AppLocalizations? of(BuildContext context) {
    return Localizations.of<AppLocalizations>(context, AppLocalizations);
  }
  static const LocalizationsDelegate<AppLocalizations> delegate =
      _AppLocalizationsDelegate();
  /// A list of this localizations delegate along with the default localizations
  /// delegates.
  ///
  /// Returns a list of localizations delegates containing this delegate along with
  /// GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate, GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
  /// and GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate.
  ///
  /// Additional delegates can be added by appending to this list in
  /// MaterialApp. This list does not have to be used at all if a custom list
  /// of delegates is preferred or required.
  static const List<LocalizationsDelegate<dynamic>> localizationsDelegates =
      <LocalizationsDelegate<dynamic>>[
        delegate,
        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
      ];
  /// A list of this localizations delegate's supported locales.
  static const List<Locale> supportedLocales = <Locale>[
    Locale('en'),
    Locale('ru'),
  ];
  /// No description provided for @appTitle.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'MemoLingvo'**
  String get appTitle;
  /// No description provided for @welcome_screen_register.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Start learning (register)'**
  String get welcome_screen_register;
  /// No description provided for @welcome_screen_login.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Login'**
  String get welcome_screen_login;
  /// No description provided for @register_screen_register.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Register'**
  String get register_screen_register;
  /// No description provided for @register_screen_email.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Email'**
  String get register_screen_email;
  /// No description provided for @register_screen_password.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Password'**
  String get register_screen_password;
  /// No description provided for @register_screen_create_account.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Create account'**
  String get register_screen_create_account;
  /// No description provided for @settings_screen_title.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Settings'**
  String get settings_screen_title;
  /// No description provided for @settings_screen_change_language.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Change language'**
  String get settings_screen_change_language;
  /// No description provided for @settings_screen_dark_mode.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:
  /// **'Dark theme'**
  String get settings_screen_dark_mode;
  /// No description provided for @settings_screen_logout.
  ///
  /// In en, this message translates to:

  String get settings_screen_logout;
  /// No description provided for @login_screen_title.

  /// In en, this message translates to:

class _AppLocalizationsDelegate
    extends LocalizationsDelegate<AppLocalizations> {
  const _AppLocalizationsDelegate();
  @override
  Future<AppLocalizations> load(Locale locale) {
    return SynchronousFuture<AppLocalizations>(lookupAppLocalizations(locale));
  }
  @override
  bool isSupported(Locale locale) =>
      <String>['en', 'ru'].contains(locale.languageCode);
  @override
  bool shouldReload(_AppLocalizationsDelegate old) => false;
}
AppLocalizations lookupAppLocalizations(Locale locale) {
  // Lookup logic when only language code is specified.
  switch (locale.languageCode) {
    case 'en':
      return AppLocalizationsEn();
    case 'ru':
      return AppLocalizationsRu();
  }
  throw FlutterError(
    'AppLocalizations.delegate failed to load unsupported locale "$locale". This is likely '
    'an issue with the localizations generation tool. Please file an issue '
    'on GitHub with a reproducible sample app and the gen-l10n configuration '
    'that was used.',
  );
}
