## `lib/core/localization/locale_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
class LocaleCubit extends Cubit<Locale> {
  final SharedPreferences preferences;
  static const String _localeKey = "app_locale";
  LocaleCubit(this.preferences) : super(_loadLocale(preferences));
  static Locale _loadLocale(SharedPreferences preferences) {
    final langCode = preferences.getString(_localeKey) ?? 'ru';
    return Locale(langCode);
  }
  void setLocale(String langCode) async {
    await preferences.setString(_localeKey, langCode);
    emit(Locale(langCode));
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/network/api_client.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
class ApiClient {
  final Dio _dio;
  ApiClient()
    : _dio = Dio(
        BaseOptions(
          baseUrl: 'http://dabilone123-001-site1.ltempurl.com/api',
          headers: {
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
          connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 10),
          receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 10),
        ),
      );
  // Пользователя мы отправляем по одному, тут оставляем Map
  // В файле: lib/core/network/api_client.dart
  // УБЕРИ старый метод pushUser и вставь эти:
  // В файле: lib/core/network/api_client.dart
  // Обнови методы loginUser и registerUser, добавив параметр uid
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> registerUser(String email, String uid) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post(
        '/Auth/register',
        data: {
          'email': email,
          'passwordHash': uid, // Передаем UID из Firebase как пароль!
        },
      );
      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {
        return response.data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('User Register', e);
    }
    return null;
  }
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> loginUser(String email, String uid) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post(
        '/Auth/login',
        data: {
          'email': email,
          'passwordHash': uid, // Передаем UID из Firebase как пароль!
        },
      );
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        return response.data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('User Login', e);
    }
    return null;
  }
  // А ЗДЕСЬ МЕНЯЕМ НА List<Map<String, dynamic>>
  Future<bool> pushDeck(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post('/Decks/sync', data: data);
      return response.statusCode == 200 ||
          response.statusCode == 201 ||
          response.statusCode == 204;
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('Deck', e);
      return false;
    }
  }
  // МЕНЯЕМ НА List
  Future<bool> pushCard(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post('/Cards/sync', data: data);
      return response.statusCode == 200 ||
          response.statusCode == 201 ||
          response.statusCode == 204;
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('Card', e);
      return false;
    }
  }
  // МЕНЯЕМ НА List
  Future<bool> pushProgress(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post('/Progress/sync', data: data);
      return response.statusCode == 200 ||
          response.statusCode == 201 ||
          response.statusCode == 204;
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('Progress', e);
      return false;
    }
  }
  // --- МЕТОДЫ PULL (ПОЛУЧЕНИЕ С СЕРВЕРА) ---
  Future<List<dynamic>> getDecks(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get('/Decks/$userId');
      return response.data as List<dynamic>; // Сервер вернет JSON-массив
    } catch (e) {
      print('Ошибка при скачивании колод: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }
  Future<List<dynamic>> getCards(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get('/Cards/sync/$userId');
      return response.data as List<dynamic>;
    } catch (e) {
      print('Ошибка при скачивании карточек: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }
  Future<List<dynamic>> getProgress(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get('/Progress/$userId');
      return response.data as List<dynamic>;
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is DioException) {
        print(
          '❌ Ошибка бэкенда при скачивании прогресса [${e.response?.statusCode}]:',
        );
        print(
          'Ответ сервера: ${e.response?.data}',
        ); // <-- Это покажет, где именно упал C#
      } else {
        print('❌ Неизвестная ошибка: $e');
      }
      return [];
    }
  }
  void _logError(String model, dynamic e) {
    if (e is DioException) {
      print('❌ Ошибка ApiClient ($model) [${e.response?.statusCode}]:');
      print('Текст ответа от сервера: ${e.response?.data}');
    } else {
      print('❌ Ошибка ApiClient ($model): $e');
    }
  }
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Игровые методы (реальная реализация)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  /// Отправить результат завершённой игры на сервер.
  /// Эндпоинт: POST /Game/SubmitResult
  Future<bool> submitGameResult({
    required String userId,
    required String gameType,
    required String result,
    required int score,
    required int timeTakenSeconds,
    required int accuracyPercent,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.post(
        '/Game/SubmitResult',
        data: {
          'userId': userId,
          'gameType': gameType,
          'result': result,
          'score': score,
          'timeTakenSeconds': timeTakenSeconds,
          'accuracyPercent': accuracyPercent,
        },
      );
      return response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201;
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('Submit Game Result', e);
      return false;
    }
  }
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getLeaderboard() async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get(
        '/Game/Leaderboard',
        options: Options(
          sendTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 5),
          receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 5),
        ),
      );
      if (response.statusCode == 200 && response.data is List) {
        return (response.data as List)
            .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('Get Leaderboard', e);
    }
    return []; // никогда не падаем
  }
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getUserProfile(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get('/User/$userId');
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        return response.data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError('GetUserProfile', e);
    }
    return null;
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/network/dictionary_api.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
class DictionaryApi {
  final Dio _dio = Dio(
    BaseOptions(
      connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 10),
      receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 10),
    ),
  );
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> fetchWordInfo(String word) async {
    try {
      final response = await _dio.get(
        'https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/$word',
      );
      if (response.statusCode == 200 &&
          response.data is List &&
          response.data.isNotEmpty) {
        return response.data[0];
      } else {
        throw Exception('API вернул неожиданный ответ');
      }
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Ошибка сети: ${e.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Неизвестная ошибка: $e');
    }
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/network/network_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
enum NetworkState { initial, online, offline }
class NetworkCubit extends Cubit<NetworkState> {
  final Connectivity _connectivity = Connectivity();
  StreamSubscription? _subscription;
  NetworkCubit() : super(NetworkState.initial) {
    _checkInitialStatus();
    _subscription = _connectivity.onConnectivityChanged.listen((results) {
      final hasInternet = !results.contains(ConnectivityResult.none);
      emit(hasInternet ? NetworkState.online : NetworkState.offline);
    });
  }
  Future<void> _checkInitialStatus() async {
    final results = await _connectivity.checkConnectivity();
    final hasInternet = !results.contains(ConnectivityResult.none);
    emit(hasInternet ? NetworkState.online : NetworkState.offline);
  }
  @override
  Future<void> close() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/notifications/notification_service.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:timezone/data/latest_all.dart' as tz;
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
class NotificationService {
  static final NotificationService _instance = NotificationService._internal();
  factory NotificationService() => _instance;
  NotificationService._internal();
  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _notificationsPlugin =
      FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
  Future<void> init() async {
    tz.initializeTimeZones();
    const AndroidInitializationSettings androidSettings =
        AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher');
    const DarwinInitializationSettings iosSettings =
        DarwinInitializationSettings();
    const InitializationSettings settings = InitializationSettings(
      android: androidSettings,
      iOS: iosSettings,
    );
    await _notificationsPlugin.initialize(settings: settings);
    _notificationsPlugin
        .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
          AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin
        >()
        ?.requestNotificationsPermission();
  }
  Future<void> scheduleWordOfTheDay(AppDatabase db) async {
    await _notificationsPlugin.cancelAll();
    final cards = await (db.select(
      db.cards,
    )..where((t) => t.isDeleted.equals(false))).get();
    if (cards.isEmpty) return;
    cards.shuffle();
    final wordsToSchedule = cards.take(7).toList();
    for (int i = 0; i < wordsToSchedule.length; i++) {
      final card = wordsToSchedule[i];
      final scheduledDate = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: i + 1));
      final tzDate = tz.TZDateTime.local(
        scheduledDate.year,
        scheduledDate.month,
        scheduledDate.day,
        12,
        0,
      );
      await _notificationsPlugin.zonedSchedule(
        id: i,
        title: 'Слово дня: ${card.word}',
        body: 'Знаете как переводится? Нажмите, чтобы проверить!',
        scheduledDate: tzDate,
        notificationDetails: const NotificationDetails(
          android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
            'word_of_day_channel',
            'Слово дня',
            channelDescription: 'Ежедневные уведомления со словами',
            importance: Importance.defaultImportance,
            priority: Priority.defaultPriority,
          ),
        ),
        androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
        matchDateTimeComponents: DateTimeComponents.time,
      );
    }
  }
}
```

## `lib/core/theme/theme_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
class ThemeCubit extends Cubit<ThemeMode> {
  final SharedPreferences preferences;
  static const String _themeKey = 'is_dark_mode';
  ThemeCubit(this.preferences) : super(_loadTheme(preferences));
  static ThemeMode _loadTheme(SharedPreferences preferences) {
    final isDark = preferences.getBool(_themeKey) ?? false;
    return isDark ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
  }
  void toggleTheme(bool isDark) async {
    await preferences.setBool(_themeKey, isDark);
    emit(isDark ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light);
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/data/models/user_model.dart`

```dart
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart' as firebase;
part 'user_model.freezed.dart';
part 'user_model.g.dart';
@freezed
sealed class UserModel with _$UserModel {
  const factory UserModel({
    required String id,
    required String email,
    String? displayName,
    String? photoUrl,
  }) = _UserModel;
  factory UserModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$UserModelFromJson(json);
  factory UserModel.fromFirebase(firebase.User user) {
    return UserModel(
      id: user.uid,
      email: user.email ?? '',
      displayName: user.displayName,
      photoUrl: user.photoURL,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
part of 'user_model.dart';
// **************************************************************************
// JsonSerializableGenerator
// **************************************************************************
_UserModel _$UserModelFromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => _UserModel(
  id: json['id'] as String,
  email: json['email'] as String,
  displayName: json['displayName'] as String?,
  photoUrl: json['photoUrl'] as String?,
);
Map<String, dynamic> _$UserModelToJson(_UserModel instance) =>
    <String, dynamic>{
      'id': instance.id,
      'email': instance.email,
      'displayName': instance.displayName,
      'photoUrl': instance.photoUrl,
    };
```

## `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
class AuthRepository {
  final FirebaseAuth _firebaseAuth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  Stream<User?> get userStatus => _firebaseAuth.authStateChanges();
  Future<UserCredential> signUp(String email, String password) async {
    return await _firebaseAuth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
      email: email,
      password: password,
    );
  }
  Future<UserCredential> signIn(String email, String password) async {
    return await _firebaseAuth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(
      email: email,
      password: password,
    );
  }
  Future<void> signOut() async => await _firebaseAuth.signOut();
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/user.dart`

```dart
import 'package:equatable/equatable.dart';
class User extends Equatable {
  final String id;
  final String? email;
  final String? displayName;
  final String? photoUrl;
  const User({
    required this.id,
    this.email,
    this.displayName,
    this.photoUrl,
  });
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [id, email, displayName, photoUrl];
  User copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? email,
    String? displayName,
    String? photoUrl,
  }) {
    return User(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      email: email ?? this.email,
      displayName: displayName ?? this.displayName,
      photoUrl: photoUrl ?? this.photoUrl,
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/domain/entities/user.dart';
abstract class AuthRepository {
  Future<User?> getCurrentUser();
  Future<User> signInWithEmailAndPassword(String email, String password);
  Future<User> signUpWithEmailAndPassword(String email, String password, String displayName);
  Future<User> signInWithGoogle();
  Future<void> signOut();
  Future<void> sendPasswordResetEmail(String email);
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_state.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
class AuthCubit extends Cubit<AuthState> {
  final AuthRepository _repository;
  final AppDatabase _db;
  AuthCubit(this._repository, this._db) : super(const AuthState.initial()) {
    _checkAuthStatus();
  }
  void _checkAuthStatus() {
    _repository.userStatus.listen((user) async {
      if (user != null) {
        try {
          final email = user.email ?? 'no_email@test.com';
          final uid = user.uid;
          var localUser = await (_db.select(
            _db.usersTable,
          )..where((t) => t.email.equals(email))).getSingleOrNull();
          if (localUser == null) {
            final apiClient = ApiClient();
            var serverData = await apiClient.loginUser(email, uid);
            if (serverData == null) {
              serverData = await apiClient.registerUser(email, uid);
            }
            if (serverData != null) {
              final serverUserId =
                  serverData['userID'] ??
                  serverData['UserID'] ??
                  serverData['userId'];
              final createdAtStr =
                  serverData['createdAt'] ?? serverData['CreatedAt'];
              await _db
                  .into(_db.usersTable)
                  .insertOnConflictUpdate(
                    UsersTableCompanion.insert(
                      id: serverUserId,
                      email: email,
                      createdAt: createdAtStr != null
                          ? DateTime.parse(createdAtStr).toUtc()
                          : DateTime.now().toUtc(),
                    ),
                  );
              print("✅ Юзер успешно сохранен с ID: $serverUserId");
              final leaderboard = await apiClient.getLeaderboard();
              print("🔍 Лидерборд получен, записей: ${leaderboard.length}");
              Map<String, dynamic>? myData;
              for (final entry in leaderboard) {
                final entryUserId =
                    entry['userId'] ?? entry['userID'] ?? entry['id'] ?? '';
                if (entryUserId == serverUserId) {
                  myData = entry;
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (myData != null) {
                final exp = (myData!['experience'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
                final rank = (myData!['rank'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
                await (_db.update(
                  _db.usersTable,
                )..where((t) => t.id.equals(serverUserId))).write(
                  UsersTableCompanion(
                    experience: Value(exp),
                    rank: Value(rank),
                  ),
                );
                print("🎮 Опыт и ранг восстановлены: опыт=$exp, ранг=$rank");
              } else {
                print(
                  "⚠️ Пользователь $serverUserId не найден в таблице лидеров",
                );
              }
            } else {
              print("❌ Ошибка: Сервер не вернул данные юзера.");
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          print("❌ Ошибка сохранения юзера в локальную БД: $e");
        }
        emit(AuthState.authenticated(user));
      } else {
        emit(const AuthState.unauthenticated());
      }
    });
  }
  Future<void> register(String email, String password) async {
    emit(const AuthState.loading());
    try {
      await _repository.signUp(email, password);
    } catch (e) {
      emit(AuthState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
  Future<void> login(String email, String password) async {
    emit(const AuthState.loading());
    try {
      await _repository.signIn(email, password);
    } catch (e) {
      emit(AuthState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
  Future<void> logout() async {
    try {
      emit(const AuthState.loading());
      await _repository.signOut();
      emit(const AuthState.unauthenticated());
    } catch (e) {
      emit(AuthState.error(e.toString()));
    }
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/logic/auth_state.dart`

```dart
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
part 'auth_state.freezed.dart';
@freezed
sealed class AuthState with _$AuthState {
  const factory AuthState.initial() = _Initial;
  const factory AuthState.loading() = _Loading;
  const factory AuthState.authenticated(User user) = _Authenticated;
  const factory AuthState.unauthenticated() = _Unauthenticated;
  const factory AuthState.error(String message) = _Error;
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/login_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_state.dart';
class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}
class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  bool _obscurePassword = true;
  late AnimationController _animationController;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animationController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
    );
    _fadeAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animationController,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
    _animationController.forward();
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _animationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  Future<void> _login() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text.trim();
    context.read<AuthCubit>().login(email, password);
  }
  void _goToRegister() {
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/register');
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: isDark
                ? [const Color(0xFF1A1A2E), const Color(0xFF16213E)]
                : [const Color(0xFF667eea), const Color(0xFF764ba2)],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24.0),
              child: FadeTransition(
                opacity: _fadeAnimation,
                child: Card(
                  elevation: 12,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
                  ),
                  color: Theme.of(context).cardTheme.color ??
                      Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
                    child: Form(
                      key: _formKey,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Center(
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.login_rounded,
                              size: 64,
                              color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          Text(
                            l10n.login_screen_title,
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .headlineMedium
                                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),
                          // Email field
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _emailController,
                            keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_email,
                              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined),
                              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                              ),
                              filled: true,
                              fillColor: Theme.of(context)
                                  .inputDecorationTheme
                                  .fillColor,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                                return l10n.add_card_screen__required_field;
                              }
                              if (!value.contains('@')) {
                                return 'Введите корректный email';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          // Password field
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _passwordController,
                            obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_password,
                              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                              suffixIcon: IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(
                                  _obscurePassword
                                      ? Icons.visibility_off
                                      : Icons.visibility,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  setState(() {
                                    _obscurePassword = !_obscurePassword;
                                  });
                                },
                              ),
                              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                              ),
                              filled: true,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                                return 'Введите пароль';
                              }
                              if (value.length < 6) {
                                return 'Пароль должен быть не менее 6 символов';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),
                          // Login button (centered, fixed width or full width)
                          BlocConsumer<AuthCubit, AuthState>(
                            listener: (context, state) {
                              state.maybeWhen(
                                authenticated: (user) {
                                  Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
                                    '/home',
                                    (route) => false,
                                  );
                                },
                                error: (msg) {
                                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                    SnackBar(
                                      content: Text(msg),
                                      backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                                      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                                    ),
                                  );
                                },
                                orElse: () {},
                              );
                            },
                            builder: (context, state) {
                              final isLoading = state.maybeWhen(
                                loading: () => true,
                                orElse: () => false,
                              );
                              return Column(
                                children: [
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    child: ElevatedButton(
                                      onPressed: isLoading ? null : _login,
                                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                        backgroundColor:
                                            Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        foregroundColor: Theme.of(context)
                                            .colorScheme
                                            .onPrimary,
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          vertical: 16,
                                        ),
                                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(40),
                                        ),
                                        elevation: 4,
                                      ),
                                      child: isLoading
                                          ? const SizedBox(
                                              height: 24,
                                              width: 24,
                                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                                strokeWidth: 2,
                                                color: Colors.white,
                                              ),
                                            )
                                          : Text(
                                              l10n.login_screen_title,
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 16,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  // Register button below login button
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    child: OutlinedButton(
                                      onPressed: isLoading ? null : _goToRegister,
                                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                                        foregroundColor:
                                            Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        side: BorderSide(
                                          color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        ),
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          vertical: 16,
                                        ),
                                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(40),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      child: Text(
                                        l10n.welcome_screen_register,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 16,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/login_sreen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_state.dart';
class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}
class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  bool _obscurePassword = true;
  late AnimationController _animationController;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animationController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
    );
    _fadeAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animationController,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
    _animationController.forward();
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _animationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  Future<void> _login() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text.trim();
    context.read<AuthCubit>().login(email, password);
  }
  void _goToRegister() {
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/register');
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: isDark
                ? [const Color(0xFF1A1A2E), const Color(0xFF16213E)]
                : [const Color(0xFF667eea), const Color(0xFF764ba2)],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24.0),
              child: FadeTransition(
                opacity: _fadeAnimation,
                child: Card(
                  elevation: 12,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
                  ),
                  color: Theme.of(context).cardTheme.color ??
                      Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
                    child: Form(
                      key: _formKey,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Center(
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.login_rounded,
                              size: 64,
                              color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          Text(
                            l10n.login_screen_title,
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .headlineMedium
                                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),
                          // Email field
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _emailController,
                            keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_email,
                              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined),
                              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                              ),
                              filled: true,
                              fillColor: Theme.of(context)
                                  .inputDecorationTheme
                                  .fillColor,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                                return l10n.add_card_screen__required_field;
                              }
                              if (!value.contains('@')) {
                                return 'Введите корректный email';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          // Password field
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _passwordController,
                            obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_password,
                              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                              suffixIcon: IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(
                                  _obscurePassword
                                      ? Icons.visibility_off
                                      : Icons.visibility,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  setState(() {
                                    _obscurePassword = !_obscurePassword;
                                  });
                                },
                              ),
                              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                              ),
                              filled: true,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                                return 'Введите пароль';
                              }
                              if (value.length < 6) {
                                return 'Пароль должен быть не менее 6 символов';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),
                          // Login button (centered, fixed width or full width)
                          BlocConsumer<AuthCubit, AuthState>(
                            listener: (context, state) {
                              state.maybeWhen(
                                authenticated: (user) {
                                  Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
                                    '/home',
                                    (route) => false,
                                  );
                                },
                                error: (msg) {
                                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                    SnackBar(
                                      content: Text(msg),
                                      backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                                      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                                    ),
                                  );
                                },
                                orElse: () {},
                              );
                            },
                            builder: (context, state) {
                              final isLoading = state.maybeWhen(
                                loading: () => true,
                                orElse: () => false,
                              );
                              return Column(
                                children: [
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    child: ElevatedButton(
                                      onPressed: isLoading ? null : _login,
                                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                                        backgroundColor:
                                            Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        foregroundColor: Theme.of(context)
                                            .colorScheme
                                            .onPrimary,
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          vertical: 16,
                                        ),
                                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(40),
                                        ),
                                        elevation: 4,
                                      ),
                                      child: isLoading
                                          ? const SizedBox(
                                              height: 24,
                                              width: 24,
                                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                                strokeWidth: 2,
                                                color: Colors.white,
                                              ),
                                            )
                                          : Text(
                                              l10n.login_screen_title,
                                              style: const TextStyle(
                                                fontSize: 16,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                  // Register button below login button
                                  SizedBox(
                                    width: double.infinity,
                                    child: OutlinedButton(
                                      onPressed: isLoading ? null : _goToRegister,
                                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                                        foregroundColor:
                                            Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        side: BorderSide(
                                          color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                        ),
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                          vertical: 16,
                                        ),
                                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                          borderRadius:
                                              BorderRadius.circular(40),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      child: Text(
                                        l10n.welcome_screen_register,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 16,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class RegisterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const RegisterScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<RegisterScreen> createState() => _RegisterScreenState();
}
class _RegisterScreenState extends State<RegisterScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  bool _obscurePassword = true;
  late AnimationController _animationController;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animationController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
    );
    _fadeAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animationController,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
    _animationController.forward();
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _animationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  Future<void> _register() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text.trim();
    context.read<AuthCubit>().register(email, password);
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

                            l10n.register_screen_register,
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .headlineMedium
                                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),

                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _emailController,

                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_email,

                                  .inputDecorationTheme
                                  .fillColor,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                                return l10n.add_card_screen__required_field;
                              }
                              if (!value.contains('@')) {
                                return 'Введите корректный email';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 16),
                          // Password field
                          TextFormField(
                            controller: _passwordController,
                            obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: l10n.register_screen_password,
                              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),

                                  _obscurePassword
                                      ? Icons.visibility_off
                                      : Icons.visibility,
                                ),

                                    _obscurePassword = !_obscurePassword;
                                  });

                              ),
                              filled: true,
                            ),
                            validator: (value) {
                              if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                                return 'Введите пароль';
                              }
                              if (value.length < 6) {
                                return 'Пароль должен быть не менее 6 символов';
                              }
                              return null;
                            },
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 32),
                          // Register button with loading state
                          BlocConsumer<AuthCubit, AuthState>(
                            listener: (context, state) {
                              state.maybeWhen(
                                authenticated: (user) {
                                  Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
                                    '/home',

                                          fontSize: 16,

                                    .bodyMedium

                                onPressed: () {
                                  Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(
                                    context,
                                    '/login',
                                  );

                                  l10n.welcome_screen_login,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,

                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),

  }
```

## `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_state.dart';
class SplashScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocListener<AuthCubit, AuthState>(
      listener: (context, state) {
        state.whenOrNull(
         authenticated: (_) => Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/home'),
         unauthenticated: () => Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/welcome'),
        );
      },
      child: const Scaffold(
        body: Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.stars, size: 100, color: Colors.blueAccent),
              SizedBox(height: 20),
              CircularProgressIndicator(),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class WelcomeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
```

## `lib/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
class CardRepository {
  final AppDatabase _db;
  final _uuid = const Uuid();
  CardRepository(this._db);
  Future<String?> getServerUserId(String email) => _db.getServerUserId(email);
  Future<void> updateCardProgress(
    String cardId,
    String userId,
    int quality,
  ) async {
    final currentProgress =
        await (_db.select(_db.cardProgress)
              ..where((t) => t.cardId.equals(cardId) & t.userId.equals(userId)))
            .getSingleOrNull();
    int repetitions = currentProgress?.repetitions ?? 0;
    double ef = currentProgress?.easinessFactor ?? 2.5;
    int interval = currentProgress?.interval ?? 0;
    DateTime nextReview;
    if (quality >= 3) {
      repetitions += 1;
      if (repetitions == 1) {
        interval = 1;
      } else if (repetitions == 2) {
        interval = 6;
      } else {
        interval = (interval * ef).round();
      }
      ef = ef + (0.1 - (5 - quality) * (0.08 + (5 - quality) * 0.02));
      if (ef < 1.3) ef = 1.3;
      nextReview = DateTime.now().toUtc().add(Duration(days: interval));
    } else {
      repetitions = 0;
      interval = 0;
      ef = ef - 0.8;
      if (ef < 1.3) ef = 1.3;
      nextReview = DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 1));
    }
    await _db
        .into(_db.cardProgress)
        .insertOnConflictUpdate(
          CardProgressCompanion.insert(
            cardId: cardId,
            userId: userId,
            nextReview: nextReview,
            easinessFactor: Value(ef),
            repetitions: Value(repetitions),
            interval: Value(interval),
            updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
            isDirty: const Value(true),
          ),
        );
    await (_db.update(_db.cards)..where((t) => t.id.equals(cardId))).write(
      CardsCompanion(
        status: Value(
          interval > 0 ? LearningStatus.mastered : LearningStatus.learning,
        ),
        updateAt: Value(DateTime.now().toUtc()),
        isDirty: const Value(true),
      ),
    );
  }
  Future<void> updateCard({
    required String id,
    required String word,
    required String translation,
    String? transcription,
    required String meaning,
    List<String>? examples,
  }) async {
    await (_db.update(_db.cards)..where((t) => t.id.equals(id))).write(
      CardsCompanion(
        word: Value(word),
        translation: Value(translation),
        transcription: Value(transcription),
        meaning: Value(meaning),
        examples: Value(examples),
        updateAt: Value(DateTime.now().toUtc()),
        isDirty: const Value(true),
      ),
    );
  }
  Stream<List<Card>> watchCards(String deckId) {
    return (_db.select(_db.cards)
          ..where((t) => t.deckId.equals(deckId))
          ..where((t) => t.isDeleted.equals(false)))
        .watch();
  }
  Stream<List<Card>> watchDueCards(String deckId, String userId) {
    final query = _db.select(_db.cards).join([
      leftOuterJoin(
        _db.cardProgress,
        _db.cardProgress.cardId.equalsExp(_db.cards.id) &
            _db.cardProgress.userId.equals(userId),
      ),
    ]);
    query.where(_db.cards.deckId.equals(deckId));
    query.where(_db.cards.isDeleted.equals(false));
    query.where(
      _db.cardProgress.cardId.isNull() |
          _db.cardProgress.nextReview.isSmallerOrEqualValue(
            DateTime.now().toUtc(),
          ),
    );
    return query.watch().map((rows) {
      return rows.map((row) => row.readTable(_db.cards)).toList();
    });
  }
  Future<List<Card>> getDueCards(String deckId, String userId) async {
    final query = _db.select(_db.cards).join([
      leftOuterJoin(
        _db.cardProgress,
        _db.cardProgress.cardId.equalsExp(_db.cards.id) &
            _db.cardProgress.userId.equals(userId),
      ),
    ]);
    query.where(_db.cards.deckId.equals(deckId));
    query.where(_db.cards.isDeleted.equals(false));
    query.where(
      _db.cardProgress.cardId.isNull() |
          _db.cardProgress.nextReview.isSmallerOrEqualValue(
            DateTime.now().toUtc(),
          ),
    );
    final rows = await query.get();
    return rows.map((row) => row.readTable(_db.cards)).toList();
  }
  Future<void> deleteCard(String id) async {
    await (_db.update(_db.cards)..where((t) => t.id.equals(id))).write(
      CardsCompanion(
        isDeleted: const Value(true),
        isDirty: const Value(true),
        updateAt: Value(DateTime.now().toUtc()),
      ),
    );
  }
  Future<void> addCard({
    required String deckId,
    required String word,
    required String translation,
    String? transcription,
    required String meaning,
    List<String>? examples,
  }) async {
    await _db
        .into(_db.cards)
        .insert(
          CardsCompanion.insert(
            id: _uuid.v4(),
            deckId: deckId,
            word: word,
            translation: translation,
            transcription: transcription != null
                ? Value(transcription)
                : const Value.absent(),
            meaning: meaning,
            examples: examples != null ? Value(examples) : const Value.absent(),
            updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
            isDirty: const Value(true),
            isDeleted: const Value(false),
          ),
        );
  }
}
```

```dart
enum LearningStatus {
  @JsonValue(0)
  newCard,
  @JsonValue(1)
  learning,
  @JsonValue(2)
  mastered,
}

  const factory Card({
    required String id,
    required String deckId,
    required String word,
    String? transcription,
    required String translation,
    String? meaning,
    List<String>? examples,
    @Default(LearningStatus.newCard) LearningStatus status,
    @Default(0) int repetitions,
    DateTime? lastSeen,
  }) = _Card;

}
```

## `lib/features/cards/domain/entities/card.g.dart`

```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
part of 'card.dart';
// **************************************************************************
// JsonSerializableGenerator
// **************************************************************************
_Card _$CardFromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => _Card(
  id: json['id'] as String,
  deckId: json['deckId'] as String,
  word: json['word'] as String,
  transcription: json['transcription'] as String?,
  translation: json['translation'] as String,
  meaning: json['meaning'] as String?,
  examples: (json['examples'] as List<dynamic>?)
      ?.map((e) => e as String)
      .toList(),
  status:
      $enumDecodeNullable(_$LearningStatusEnumMap, json['status']) ??
      LearningStatus.newCard,
  repetitions: (json['repetitions'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
  lastSeen: json['lastSeen'] == null
      ? null
      : DateTime.parse(json['lastSeen'] as String),
);
Map<String, dynamic> _$CardToJson(_Card instance) => <String, dynamic>{
  'id': instance.id,
  'deckId': instance.deckId,
  'word': instance.word,
  'transcription': instance.transcription,
  'translation': instance.translation,
  'meaning': instance.meaning,
  'examples': instance.examples,
  'status': _$LearningStatusEnumMap[instance.status]!,
  'repetitions': instance.repetitions,
  'lastSeen': instance.lastSeen?.toIso8601String(),
};
const _$LearningStatusEnumMap = {
  LearningStatus.newCard: 0,
  LearningStatus.learning: 1,
  LearningStatus.mastered: 2,
};
```

## `lib/features/cards/logic/training_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:flutter_card_swiper/flutter_card_swiper.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'dart:async';
class TrainingState {
  final List<Card> cards;
  final int currentIndex;
  final bool isFinished;
  TrainingState({
    required this.cards,
    this.currentIndex = 0,
    this.isFinished = false,
  });
  TrainingState copyWith({
    List<Card>? cards,
    int? currentIndex,
    bool? isFinished,
  }) {
    return TrainingState(
      cards: cards ?? this.cards,
      currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
      isFinished: isFinished ?? this.isFinished,
    );
  }
}
class TrainingCubit extends Cubit<TrainingState> {
  final CardRepository _repository;
  final String deckId;
  TrainingCubit(this._repository, this.deckId)
    : super(TrainingState(cards: [])) {
    _init();
  }
  void _init() async {
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (user?.email == null) return;
    final serverId = await _repository.getServerUserId(user!.email!);
    if (serverId == null) return;
    final cards = await _repository.getDueCards(deckId, serverId);
    emit(
      TrainingState(cards: cards, isFinished: cards.isEmpty, currentIndex: 0),
    );
  }
  void handleSwipe(int index, CardSwiperDirection direction) async {
    if (state.cards.isEmpty || index >= state.cards.length) return;
    final card = state.cards[index];
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    final serverId = await _repository.getServerUserId(user!.email!);
    if (direction == CardSwiperDirection.right) {
      if (index >= state.cards.length - 1) {
        emit(state.copyWith(isFinished: true));
      }
      await _repository.updateCardProgress(card.id, serverId!, 5);
    } else {
      await _repository.updateCardProgress(card.id, serverId!, 1);
      final updatedCards = List<Card>.from(state.cards);
      updatedCards.add(card);
      emit(state.copyWith(cards: updatedCards));
    }
    if (index >= state.cards.length - 1) {
      emit(state.copyWith(isFinished: true));
    }
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/cards/presentation/screens/add_card_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/dictionary_api.dart';
class AddCardScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String deckId;
  final db.Card? cardToEdit;
  const AddCardScreen({super.key, required this.deckId, this.cardToEdit});
  @override
  State<AddCardScreen> createState() => _AddCardScreenState();
}
class _AddCardScreenState extends State<AddCardScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _wordController = TextEditingController();
  final _translationController = TextEditingController();
  final _transcriptionController = TextEditingController();
  final _meaningController = TextEditingController();
  final List<TextEditingController> _examplecontrollers = [];
  bool _isLoadingFromApi = false;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.cardToEdit != null) {
      _wordController.text = widget.cardToEdit!.word;
      _translationController.text = widget.cardToEdit!.translation;
      _transcriptionController.text = widget.cardToEdit!.transcription ?? '';
      _meaningController.text = widget.cardToEdit!.meaning;
      if (widget.cardToEdit!.examples != null) {
        for (var example in widget.cardToEdit!.examples!) {
          _examplecontrollers.add(TextEditingController(text: example));
        }
      }
    }
  }
  void _addExampleField() {
    setState(() {
      _examplecontrollers.add(TextEditingController());
    });
  }
  void _removeExampleField(int index) {
    setState(() {
      _examplecontrollers[index].dispose();
      _examplecontrollers.removeAt(index);
    });
  }
  Future<void> _fetchWordData() async {
    final word = _wordController.text.trim();
    if (word.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Сначала введите английское слово')),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _isLoadingFromApi = true);
    final api = DictionaryApi();
    final data = await api.fetchWordInfo(word);
    setState(() => _isLoadingFromApi = false);
    if (data != null) {
      setState(() {
        if (data['phonetic'] != null) {
          _transcriptionController.text = data['phonetic'].replaceAll('/', '');
        } else if (data['phonetics'] != null && data['phonetics'].isNotEmpty) {
          _transcriptionController.text =
              data['phonetics'][0]['text']?.replaceAll('/', '') ?? '';
        }
        if (data['meanings'] != null && data['meanings'].isNotEmpty) {
          final firstMeaning = data['meanings'][0];
          if (firstMeaning['definitions'] != null &&
              firstMeaning['definitions'].isNotEmpty) {
            final def = firstMeaning['definitions'][0];
            _meaningController.text = def['definition'] ?? '';
            if (def['example'] != null) {
              if (_examplecontrollers.isEmpty) {
                _examplecontrollers.add(
                  TextEditingController(text: def['example']),
                );
              } else {
                _examplecontrollers[0].text = def['example'];
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Данные успешно загружены!'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.green,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Слово не найдено (API поддерживает только англ. слова)',
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _wordController.dispose();
    _transcriptionController.dispose();
    _translationController.dispose();
    _meaningController.dispose();
    for (var i in _examplecontrollers) {
      i.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }
  Future<void> _saveCard() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      final examples = _examplecontrollers
          .map((i) => i.text.trim())
          .where((text) => text.isNotEmpty)
          .toList();
      final rep = context.read<CardRepository>();
      final transcription = _transcriptionController.text.trim().isEmpty
          ? null
          : _transcriptionController.text.trim();
      if (widget.cardToEdit != null) {
        await rep.updateCard(
          id: widget.cardToEdit!.id,
          word: _wordController.text.trim(),
          translation: _translationController.text.trim(),
          transcription: transcription,
          meaning: _meaningController.text.trim(),
          examples: examples.isEmpty ? null : examples,
        );
      } else {
        await rep.addCard(
          deckId: widget.deckId,
          word: _wordController.text.trim(),
          translation: _translationController.text.trim(),
          transcription: transcription,
          meaning: _meaningController.text.trim(),
          examples: examples.isEmpty ? null : examples,
        );
      }
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.add_card_screen__new_card),
        actions: [
          IconButton(onPressed: _saveCard, icon: const Icon(Icons.check)),
        ],
      ),
      body: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            _buildTextField(
              _wordController,
              l10n.add_card_screen__word,
              isRequired: true,
              suffixIcon: IconButton(
                icon: _isLoadingFromApi
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        width: 20,
                        height: 20,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.auto_fix_high, color: Colors.blue),
                tooltip: 'Заполнить из интернета (только англ)',
                onPressed: _isLoadingFromApi ? null : _fetchWordData,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _buildTextField(
              _translationController,
              l10n.add_card_screen__translation,
              isRequired: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _buildTextField(
              _transcriptionController,
              l10n.add_card_screen__transcription,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _buildTextField(
              _meaningController,
              l10n.add_card_screen__meaning,
              maxLines: 2,
            ),
            const Divider(height: 40),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  l10n.add_card_screen__examples,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _addExampleField,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                  label: Text(l10n.add_card_screen__add_example),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            ..._examplecontrollers.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: entry.value,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: l10n.add_card_screen__add_example_hint,
                          border: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => _removeExampleField(entry.key),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: Colors.red),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildTextField(
    TextEditingController controller,
    String label, {
    bool isRequired = false,
    int maxLines = 1,
    Widget? suffixIcon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      maxLines: maxLines,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
        border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      ),
      validator: (value) {
        if (isRequired && (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty)) {
          return AppLocalizations.of(context)!.add_card_screen__required_field;
        }
        return null;
      },
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/cards/presentation/screens/training_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:flutter_card_swiper/flutter_card_swiper.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/logic/training_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/presentation/widgets/flashcard.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart';
class TrainingScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final String deckId;
  const TrainingScreen({super.key, required this.deckId});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (context) =>
          TrainingCubit(context.read<CardRepository>(), deckId),
      child: const _TrainingScreenContent(),
    );
  }
}
class _TrainingScreenContent extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TrainingScreenContent();
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(l10n.trainig_screen__training)),
      body: BlocBuilder<TrainingCubit, TrainingState>(
        builder: (context, state) {
          if (state.cards.isEmpty) {
            return Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.auto_awesome,
                      size: 80,
                      color: Colors.amber,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    const Text(
                      "Все карточки в этой колоде выучены!",
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    const Text(
                      "Возвращайтесь позже, когда придет время для повторения.",
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),
                    ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                      child: const Text("Назад к колодам"),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          }
          if (state.isFinished) {
            return Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.emoji_events,
                    size: 80,
                    color: Colors.orange,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(
                    l10n.trainig_screen__training_done,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    child: const Text("Назад к колодам"),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }
          return SafeArea(
            child: CardSwiper(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              allowedSwipeDirection: const AllowedSwipeDirection.symmetric(
                horizontal: true,
              ),
              numberOfCardsDisplayed: state.cards.length > 1 ? 2 : 1,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 40),
              cardBuilder:
                  (
                    context,
                    index,
                    horizontalOffsetPercentage,
                    verticalOffsetPercentage,
                  ) {
                    final card = state.cards[index];
                    final double offset = horizontalOffsetPercentage / 100;
                    return FlashcardWidget(
                      key: ValueKey('${card.id}_$index'),
                      card: card,
                      horizontalOffset: offset,
                    );
                  },
              onSwipe: (previousIndex, currentIndex, direction) {
                context.read<TrainingCubit>().handleSwipe(
                  previousIndex,
                  direction,
                );
                return true;
              },
              cardsCount: state.cards.length,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}
```
