## `lib/features/cards/presentation/widgets/flashcard.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
class FlashcardWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final db.Card card;
  final double horizontalOffset;
  const FlashcardWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.card,
    this.horizontalOffset = 0,
  });
  @override
  State<StatefulWidget> createState() => FlashcardWidgetState();
}
class FlashcardWidgetState extends State<FlashcardWidget>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _animation;
  bool _isFront = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
    );
    _animation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0,
      end: 1,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeInOut));
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  void _flipCard() {
    if (_isFront) {
      _controller.forward();
    } else {
      _controller.reverse();
    }
    _isFront = !_isFront;
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _flipCard,
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _animation,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final angle = _animation.value * pi;
          final transform = Matrix4.identity()
            ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.001)
            ..rotateY(angle);
          final isFrontVisible = angle < (pi / 2);
          return Transform(
            transform: transform,
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                isFrontVisible
                    ? _buildFrontSide()
                    : Transform(
                        transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(pi),
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        child: _buildBackSide(),
                      ),
                _buildSwipeOverlay(),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildSwipeOverlay() {
    if (widget.horizontalOffset == 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final bool isRight = widget.horizontalOffset > 0;
    final double opacity = (widget.horizontalOffset.abs() * 0.8).clamp(
      0.0,
      0.8,
    );
    final Color overlayColor = isRight ? Colors.green : Colors.red;
    final IconData icon = isRight
        ? Icons.check_circle_outline
        : Icons.highlight_off;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25),
        color: overlayColor.withOpacity(opacity),
      ),
      child: Center(
        child: Opacity(
          opacity: (widget.horizontalOffset.abs() * 2).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
          child: Icon(icon, size: 100, color: Colors.white),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildFrontSide() {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    return Card(
      elevation: 8,
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      shadowColor: Colors.black26,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25)),
      color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
      child: Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.card.word,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 36,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              if (widget.card.transcription != null &&
                  widget.card.transcription!.isNotEmpty)
                Text(
                  "[${widget.card.transcription}]",
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 22,
                    color:
                        Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.color ??
                        Colors.grey,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  ),
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 40),
              Icon(
                Icons.touch_app,
                size: 24,
                color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.5),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                l10n.flash_card__tap_to_flip,
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.8)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildBackSide() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 8,
      margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
      shadowColor: Colors.black26,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25)),
      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
      child: Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  widget.card.translation,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 32,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (widget.card.meaning != null &&
                    widget.card.meaning!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const Divider(),
                  Text(
                    widget.card.meaning!,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      color: Theme.of(
                        context,
                      ).colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer.withOpacity(0.8),
                    ),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ],
                if (widget.card.examples != null &&
                    widget.card.examples!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.black12,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      children: widget.card.examples!
                          .map(
                            (example) => Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                vertical: 4.0,
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                "• $example",
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                                  color: Theme.of(
                                    context,
                                  ).colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          )
                          .toList(),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/decks/data/repositories/deck_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
class DeckRepository {
  final AppDatabase _db;
  DeckRepository(this._db);
  final _uuid = const Uuid();
  Stream<List<DeckWithCount>> watchDecksWithCount(String userId) =>
      _db.watchDecksWithCardCount(userId);
  Future<String?> getServerUserId(String email) => _db.getServerUserId(email);
  Future<void> importDeck(String code, String currentUserId) async {
    final parts = code.split('_');
    if (parts.length != 2) throw Exception("Неверный формат кода");
    final sourceUserId = parts[0];
    final sourceDeckId = parts[1];
    final api = ApiClient();
    final serverDecks = await api.getDecks(sourceUserId);
    final deckMap = serverDecks.firstWhere(
      (d) => d['deckID'] == sourceDeckId,
      orElse: () => <String, dynamic>{},
    );
    if (deckMap.isEmpty) throw Exception("Колода не найдена или удалена");
    final serverCards = await api.getCards(sourceUserId);
    final deckCards = serverCards
        .where((c) => c['deckID'] == sourceDeckId)
        .toList();
    final newDeckId = _uuid.v4();
    await _db
        .into(_db.decks)
        .insert(
          DecksCompanion.insert(
            id: newDeckId,
            userId: currentUserId,
            title: deckMap['title'] + " (Импорт)",
            description: deckMap['description'] != null
                ? Value(deckMap['description'])
                : const Value.absent(),
            updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
            isDirty: const Value(true),
            isDeleted: const Value(false),
          ),
        );
    for (var c in deckCards) {
      List<String>? parsedExamples;
      if (c['examples'] != null && c['examples'].toString().isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          parsedExamples = List<String>.from(jsonDecode(c['examples']));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      await _db
          .into(_db.cards)
          .insert(
            CardsCompanion.insert(
              id: _uuid.v4(),
              deckId: newDeckId,
              word: c['word'],
              translation: c['translation'],
              transcription: c['transcription'] != null
                  ? Value(c['transcription'])
                  : const Value.absent(),
              meaning: c['meaning'] ?? '',
              examples: parsedExamples != null
                  ? Value(parsedExamples)
                  : const Value.absent(),
              updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
              isDirty: const Value(true),
              isDeleted: const Value(false),
            ),
          );
    }
  }
  Future<void> createDeck(
    String title,
    String? description,
    String currentUserId,
  ) async {
    await _db
        .into(_db.decks)
        .insert(
          DecksCompanion.insert(
            id: _uuid.v4(),
            userId: currentUserId,
            title: title,
            description: description != null
                ? Value(description)
                : const Value.absent(),
            updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
            isDirty: const Value(true),
            isDeleted: const Value(false),
          ),
        );
  }
  Future<void> deleteDeck(String id) async {
    await (_db.update(_db.decks)..where((t) => t.id.equals(id))).write(
      DecksCompanion(
        isDeleted: const Value(true),
        isDirty: const Value(true),
        updateAt: Value(DateTime.now().toUtc()),
      ),
    );
  }
  Future<void> updateDeck(Deck deck) async {
    await _db
        .update(_db.decks)
        .replace(
          deck.copyWith(isDirty: true, updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc()),
        );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/decks/logic/deck_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/data/repositories/deck_repository.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
class DeckCubit extends Cubit<List<DeckWithCount>> {
  final DeckRepository _repository;
  StreamSubscription? _dbSubscription;
  StreamSubscription? _authSubscription;
  DeckCubit(this._repository) : super([]) {
    _authSubscription = FirebaseAuth.instance.authStateChanges().listen((
      user,
    ) async {
      if (user != null && user.email != null) {
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
        final serverId = await _repository.getServerUserId(user.email!);
        if (serverId != null) {
          _listenToDecks(serverId);
        } else {
          print("❌ Ошибка DeckCubit: Не удалось найти serverId в локальной БД");
        }
      } else {
        _dbSubscription?.cancel();
        emit([]);
      }
    });
  }
  Future<void> importDeckByCode(String code) async {
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
    if (email != null) {
      final serverId = await _repository.getServerUserId(email);
      if (serverId != null) {
        await _repository.importDeck(code, serverId);
      }
    }
  }
  void _listenToDecks(String userId) {
    _dbSubscription?.cancel();
    _dbSubscription = _repository.watchDecksWithCount(userId).listen((items) {
      emit(items);
    });
  }
  Future<void> updateDeck(Deck deck) async {
    await _repository.updateDeck(deck);
  }
  Future<void> addDeck(String title, String? description) async {
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
    if (email != null) {
      final serverId = await _repository.getServerUserId(email);
      if (serverId != null) {
        await _repository.createDeck(title, description, serverId);
      }
    }
  }
  Future<void> deleteDeck(String id) async {
    await _repository.deleteDeck(id);
  }
  @override
  Future<void> close() {
    _dbSubscription?.cancel();
    _authSubscription?.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/decks/presentation/screens/manage_deck_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as app;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/data/repositories/card_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/presentation/screens/add_card_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/presentation/widgets/deck_info_section.dart';
class ManageDeckScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final Deck deck;
  const ManageDeckScreen({super.key, required this.deck});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(deck.title),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AddCardScreen(deckId: deck.id)),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          DeckInfoSection(deck: deck),
          const Divider(),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
            child: Text(
              l10n.manage_deck_screen__cards_list_title,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: StreamBuilder<List<app.Card>>(
              stream: context.read<CardRepository>().watchCards(deck.id),
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting;
                final cards = snapshot.data ?? [];
                if (cards.isEmpty) {
                  return Center(child: Text(l10n.manage_deck_screen__no_cards));
                }
                return ListView.builder(
                  itemCount: cards.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final card = cards[index];
                    return ListTile(
                      title: Text(card.word),
                      subtitle: Text(card.translation),
                      trailing: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          IconButton(
                            onPressed: () {
                              Navigator.push(
                                context,
                                MaterialPageRoute(
                                  builder: (_) => AddCardScreen(
                                    deckId: deck.id,
                                    cardToEdit: card,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                            icon: Icon(Icons.edit, size: 20),
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            onPressed: () => context
                                .read<CardRepository>()
                                .deleteCard(card.id),
                            icon: const Icon(
                              Icons.delete_outline,
                              color: Colors.red,
                              size: 20,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/decks/presentation/widgets/deck_info_section.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart' as material;
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:drift/drift.dart' as drift;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/logic/deck_cubit.dart';
class DeckInfoSection extends StatelessWidget {
  final Deck deck;
  const DeckInfoSection({required this.deck});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return material.Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    deck.title,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: () => _showEditDialog(context, deck),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (deck.description != null && deck.description!.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                deck.description!,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showEditDialog(BuildContext context, Deck deck) {
    final titleController = TextEditingController(text: deck.title);
    final descriptionController = TextEditingController(
      text: deck.description ?? '',
    );
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_edit_deck),
        content: material.Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: titleController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_hint_title,
                labelText: l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_title_label,
              ),
              autofocus: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: descriptionController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText:
                    l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_hint_description,
                labelText:
                    l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_description_label,
              ),
              maxLines: 3,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              if (titleController.text.trim().isEmpty) {
                return;
              }
              final updatedDeck = deck.copyWith(
                title: titleController.text.trim(),
                description: drift.Value(
                  descriptionController.text.trim().isEmpty
                      ? null
                      : descriptionController.text.trim(),
                ),
                isDirty: true,
                updateAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
              );
              context.read<DeckCubit>().updateDeck(updatedDeck);
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
            child: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_edit_deck_dialog_save),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/data/models/game_session_model.g.dart`

```dart
// GENERATED CODE - DO NOT MODIFY BY HAND
part of 'game_session_model.dart';
// **************************************************************************
// JsonSerializableGenerator
// **************************************************************************
_GameSessionModel _$GameSessionModelFromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
    _GameSessionModel(
      id: json['id'] as String,
      userId: json['userId'] as String,
      gameType: json['gameType'] as String,
      result: json['result'] as String,
      score: (json['score'] as num).toInt(),
      timeTakenSeconds: (json['timeTakenSeconds'] as num).toInt(),
      accuracyPercent: (json['accuracyPercent'] as num).toInt(),
      playedAt: DateTime.parse(json['playedAt'] as String),
    );
Map<String, dynamic> _$GameSessionModelToJson(_GameSessionModel instance) =>
    <String, dynamic>{
      'id': instance.id,
      'userId': instance.userId,
      'gameType': instance.gameType,
      'result': instance.result,
      'score': instance.score,
      'timeTakenSeconds': instance.timeTakenSeconds,
      'accuracyPercent': instance.accuracyPercent,
      'playedAt': instance.playedAt.toIso8601String(),
    };
```

## `lib/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
class GameRepository {
  final AppDatabase _db;
  final ApiClient _api;
  final _uuid = const Uuid();
  GameRepository(this._db, this._api);
  AppDatabase get database => _db;
  Future<void> saveGameResult({
    required String userId,
    required String gameType,
    required String result,
    required int score,
    required int timeTakenSeconds,
    required int accuracyPercent,
  }) async {
    final sessionId = _uuid.v4();
    final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();
    await _db
        .into(_db.gameSessions)
        .insert(
          GameSessionsCompanion.insert(
            id: sessionId,
            userId: userId,
            gameType: gameType,
            result: result,
            score: score,
            timeTakenSeconds: timeTakenSeconds,
            accuracyPercent: accuracyPercent,
            playedAt: now,
            updateAt: now,
            isDirty: const Value(true),
          ),
        );
    final currentUser = await (_db.select(
      _db.usersTable,
    )..where((t) => t.id.equals(userId))).getSingleOrNull();
    if (currentUser != null) {
      int newExp = currentUser.experience + score;
      int newRank = _calculateRank(newExp);
      await (_db.update(
        _db.usersTable,
      )..where((t) => t.id.equals(userId))).write(
        UsersTableCompanion(experience: Value(newExp), rank: Value(newRank)),
      );
    }
    try {
      bool sent = await _api.submitGameResult(
        userId: userId,
        gameType: gameType,
        result: result,
        score: score,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTakenSeconds,
        accuracyPercent: accuracyPercent,
      );
      if (sent) {
        final leaderboard = await _api.getLeaderboard();
        Map<String, dynamic>? serverEntry;
        for (final entry in leaderboard) {
          final id = entry['userId'] ?? entry['userID'] ?? entry['id'] ?? '';
          if (id == userId) {
            serverEntry = entry;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (serverEntry != null) {
          final serverExp = (serverEntry['experience'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
          final serverRank = (serverEntry['rank'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
          await (_db.update(
            _db.usersTable,
          )..where((t) => t.id.equals(userId))).write(
            UsersTableCompanion(
              experience: Value(serverExp),
              rank: Value(serverRank),
            ),
          );
          print('✅ Опыт синхронизирован с сервером: $serverExp XP');
        } else {
          print(
            '⚠️ Не удалось найти себя в лидерборде, опыт может расходиться',
          );
        }
      } else {
        print('⚠️ Сервер не принял результат, опыт остался локальным');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('❌ Ошибка синхронизации с сервером: $e');
    }
  }
  int _calculateRank(int exp) {
    if (exp < 4000) return 0;
    if (exp < 8000) return 1;
    if (exp < 12000) return 2;
    if (exp < 16000) return 3;
    return 4;
  }
  Stream<List<GameSession>> watchSessions(String userId) {
    final query = _db.select(_db.gameSessions)
      ..where((t) => t.userId.equals(userId))
      ..orderBy([
        (t) => OrderingTerm(expression: t.playedAt, mode: OrderingMode.desc),
      ]);
    return query.watch();
  }
  Future<List<UserRank>> getLeaderboard() async {
    try {
      final serverData = await _api.getLeaderboard();
      if (serverData.isNotEmpty) {
        return serverData.map((json) {
          final id = json['userId'] ?? json['userID'] ?? json['id'] ?? '';
          final email = json['email'] ?? json['Email'] ?? 'unknown';
          final exp =
              (json['experience'] ??
                      json['experiencePoints'] ??
                      json['xp'] ??
                      0)
                  as int;
          final rnk = (json['rank'] ?? json['playerRank'] ?? 0) as int;
          return UserRank(userId: id, email: email, experience: exp, rank: rnk);
        }).toList();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Ошибка при обработке таблицы лидеров: $e');
    }
    return getLocalLeaderboard();
  }
  Future<UserRank?> getUserRank(String serverUserId) async {
    final user = await (_db.select(
      _db.usersTable,
    )..where((t) => t.id.equals(serverUserId))).getSingleOrNull();
    if (user == null) return null;
    return UserRank(
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      experience: user.experience,
      rank: user.rank,
    );
  }
  Future<List<DeckWithCount>> getDecksForUser(String userId) async {
    return _db.watchDecksWithCardCount(userId).first;
  }
  Future<List<UserRank>> getLocalLeaderboard() async {
    final users =
        await (_db.select(_db.usersTable)
              ..orderBy([
                (t) => OrderingTerm(
                  expression: t.experience,
                  mode: OrderingMode.desc,
                ),
              ])
              ..limit(20))
            .get();
    return users
        .map(
          (u) => UserRank(
            userId: u.id,
            email: u.email,
            experience: u.experience,
            rank: u.rank,
          ),
        )
        .toList();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/domain/entities/game_session.dart`

```dart
import 'package:equatable/equatable.dart';
class GameSession extends Equatable {
  final String id;
  final String userId;
  final String gameType;
  final String result;
  final int score;
  final int timeTakenSeconds;
  final int accuracyPercent;
  final DateTime playedAt;
  const GameSession({
    required this.id,
    required this.userId,
    required this.gameType,
    required this.result,
    required this.score,
    required this.timeTakenSeconds,
    required this.accuracyPercent,
    required this.playedAt,
  });
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [
    id,
    userId,
    gameType,
    result,
    score,
    timeTakenSeconds,
    accuracyPercent,
    playedAt,
  ];
```

## `lib/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart`

```dart
class UserRank {
  final String userId;
  final String email;
  final int experience;
  final int rank;
  const UserRank({
    required this.userId,
    required this.email,
    required this.experience,
    required this.rank,
  });
  String get rankName {
    switch (rank) {
      case 0:
        return 'Новичок';
      case 1:
        return 'Любитель';
      case 2:
        return 'Знаток';
      case 3:
        return 'Мастер';
      default:
        return 'Легенда';
    }
  }
  int get experienceToNextRank => (rank + 1) * 4000;
  double get progress => experience / experienceToNextRank;
}
```

## `lib/features/games/logic/games_menu_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
class GamesMenuState {
  final UserRank? userRank;
  final int totalGamesPlayed;
  final int wins;
  const GamesMenuState({
    this.userRank,
    this.totalGamesPlayed = 0,
    this.wins = 0,
  });
  GamesMenuState copyWith({
    UserRank? userRank,
    int? totalGamesPlayed,
    int? wins,
  }) {
    return GamesMenuState(
      userRank: userRank ?? this.userRank,
      totalGamesPlayed: totalGamesPlayed ?? this.totalGamesPlayed,
      wins: wins ?? this.wins,
    );
  }
}
class GamesMenuCubit extends Cubit<GamesMenuState> {
  final GameRepository _repo;
  GamesMenuCubit(this._repo) : super(GamesMenuState());
  Future<void> loadStats(String email) async {  
    final userId = await _repo.database.getServerUserId(email);
    if (userId == null) {
      emit(GamesMenuState());
      return;
    }
    final rank = await _repo.getUserRank(userId);
    final sessions = await _repo.watchSessions(userId).first;
    final wins = sessions.where((s) => s.result == 'win').length;
    emit(
      GamesMenuState(
        userRank: rank,
        totalGamesPlayed: sessions.length,
        wins: wins,
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/logic/sprint_pairs_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
class Pair {
  final String cardId;
  final String word;
  final String translation;
  const Pair(this.cardId, this.word, this.translation);
}
class SprintPairsState {
  final List<Pair> remainingPairs;
  final List<Pair> shuffledLeft;
  final List<Pair> shuffledRight;
  final String? selectedLeftId;
  final String? selectedRightId;
  final int playerScore;
  final int pairsFound;
  final int totalPairs;
  final bool isFinished;
  final int totalTimeLeft;
  const SprintPairsState({
    required this.remainingPairs,
    required this.shuffledLeft,
    required this.shuffledRight,
    this.selectedLeftId,
    this.selectedRightId,
    required this.playerScore,
    required this.pairsFound,
    required this.totalPairs,
    required this.isFinished,
    required this.totalTimeLeft,
  });
  factory SprintPairsState.initial(List<Pair> pairs, int timePerGame) {
    final left = List<Pair>.from(pairs)..shuffle();
    final right = List<Pair>.from(pairs)..shuffle();
    return SprintPairsState(
      remainingPairs: List<Pair>.from(pairs),
      shuffledLeft: left,
      shuffledRight: right,
      playerScore: 0,
      pairsFound: 0,
      totalPairs: pairs.length,
      isFinished: false,
      totalTimeLeft: timePerGame,
    );
  }
  SprintPairsState copyWith({
    List<Pair>? remainingPairs,
    List<Pair>? shuffledLeft,
    List<Pair>? shuffledRight,
    String? selectedLeftId,
    String? selectedRightId,
    int? playerScore,
    int? pairsFound,
    int? totalPairs,
    bool? isFinished,
    int? totalTimeLeft,
  }) {
    return SprintPairsState(
      remainingPairs: remainingPairs ?? this.remainingPairs,
      shuffledLeft: shuffledLeft ?? this.shuffledLeft,
      shuffledRight: shuffledRight ?? this.shuffledRight,
      selectedLeftId: selectedLeftId ?? this.selectedLeftId,
      selectedRightId: selectedRightId ?? this.selectedRightId,
      playerScore: playerScore ?? this.playerScore,
      pairsFound: pairsFound ?? this.pairsFound,
      totalPairs: totalPairs ?? this.totalPairs,
      isFinished: isFinished ?? this.isFinished,
      totalTimeLeft: totalTimeLeft ?? this.totalTimeLeft,
    );
  }
}
class SprintPairsCubit extends Cubit<SprintPairsState> {
  final GameRepository _repository;
  final String email;
  Timer? _gameTimer;
  DateTime? _sessionStartTime;
  SprintPairsCubit(this._repository, this.email, List<db.Card> cards)
    : super(
        SprintPairsState.initial(
          cards.map((c) => Pair(c.id, c.word, c.translation)).toList(),
          90,
        ),
      ) {
    _sessionStartTime = DateTime.now();
    _startGameTimer();
  }
  void _startGameTimer() {
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    _gameTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.isFinished) return;
      if (state.totalTimeLeft <= 1) {
        _finishGame();
      } else {
        emit(state.copyWith(totalTimeLeft: state.totalTimeLeft - 1));
      }
    });
  }
  void selectLeft(String cardId) {
    if (state.selectedLeftId == cardId) {
      emit(state.copyWith(selectedLeftId: null));
    } else {
      emit(state.copyWith(selectedLeftId: cardId));
      _checkMatch();
    }
  }
  void selectRight(String cardId) {
    if (state.selectedRightId == cardId) {
      emit(state.copyWith(selectedRightId: null));
    } else {
      emit(state.copyWith(selectedRightId: cardId));
      _checkMatch();
    }
  }
  void _checkMatch() {
    if (state.selectedLeftId != null && state.selectedRightId != null) {
      final leftId = state.selectedLeftId!;
      final rightId = state.selectedRightId!;
      if (leftId == rightId) {
        final newRemaining = state.remainingPairs
            .where((p) => p.cardId != leftId)
            .toList();
        final newLeft = List<Pair>.from(newRemaining)..shuffle();
        final newRight = List<Pair>.from(newRemaining)..shuffle();
        final roundScore = 50 + state.totalTimeLeft;
        final newScore = state.playerScore + roundScore;
        final newPairsFound = state.pairsFound + 1;
        emit(
          state.copyWith(
            remainingPairs: newRemaining,
            shuffledLeft: newLeft,
            shuffledRight: newRight,
            playerScore: newScore,
            pairsFound: newPairsFound,
            selectedLeftId: null,
            selectedRightId: null,
          ),
        );
        if (newRemaining.isEmpty) {
          _finishGame();
        }
      } else {
        emit(
          state.copyWith(
            selectedLeftId: null,
            selectedRightId: null,
            playerScore: state.playerScore - 10,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }
  Future<void> _finishGame() async {
    if (state.isFinished) return;
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    final totalTime = DateTime.now().difference(_sessionStartTime!).inSeconds;
    final accuracy = state.totalPairs > 0
        ? ((state.pairsFound / state.totalPairs) * 100).toInt()
        : 0;
    final serverUserId = await _repository.database.getServerUserId(email);
    if (serverUserId != null) {
      await _repository.saveGameResult(
        userId: serverUserId,
        gameType: 'sprint_pairs',
        result: 'completed',
        score: state.playerScore,
        timeTakenSeconds: totalTime,
        accuracyPercent: accuracy,
      );
    }
    emit(state.copyWith(isFinished: true));
  }
  @override
  Future<void> close() {
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/logic/word_duel_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
class WordDuelState {
  final List<String> shuffledLetters;
  final List<String> playerAnswer;
  final String targetWord;
  final String promptWord;
  final int playerScore;
  final int round;
  final int totalRounds;
  final bool isFinished;
  final int totalTimeLeft;
  const WordDuelState({
    required this.shuffledLetters,
    required this.playerAnswer,
    required this.targetWord,
    required this.promptWord,
    required this.playerScore,
    required this.round,
    required this.totalRounds,
    required this.isFinished,
    required this.totalTimeLeft,
  });
  factory WordDuelState.initial(int totalRounds, int totalTime) =>
      WordDuelState(
        shuffledLetters: [],
        playerAnswer: [],
        targetWord: '',
        promptWord: '',
        playerScore: 0,
        round: 0,
        totalRounds: totalRounds,
        isFinished: false,
        totalTimeLeft: totalTime,
      );
  WordDuelState copyWith({
    List<String>? shuffledLetters,
    List<String>? playerAnswer,
    String? targetWord,
    String? promptWord,
    int? playerScore,
    int? round,
    int? totalRounds,
    bool? isFinished,
    int? totalTimeLeft,
  }) {
    return WordDuelState(
      shuffledLetters: shuffledLetters ?? this.shuffledLetters,
      playerAnswer: playerAnswer ?? this.playerAnswer,
      targetWord: targetWord ?? this.targetWord,
      promptWord: promptWord ?? this.promptWord,
      playerScore: playerScore ?? this.playerScore,
      round: round ?? this.round,
      totalRounds: totalRounds ?? this.totalRounds,
      isFinished: isFinished ?? this.isFinished,
      totalTimeLeft: totalTimeLeft ?? this.totalTimeLeft,
    );
  }
}
class WordDuelCubit extends Cubit<WordDuelState> {
  final GameRepository _repository;
  final String email;
  Timer? _gameTimer;
  final List<db.Card> _cards;
  DateTime? _sessionStartTime;
  static const int totalGameTime = 90;
  WordDuelCubit(this._repository, this.email, this._cards)
    : super(
        WordDuelState.initial(
          _cards.length > 5 ? 5 : _cards.length,
          totalGameTime,
        ),
      ) {
    _sessionStartTime = DateTime.now();
    _startGameTimer();
    _startRound();
  }
  void _startGameTimer() {
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    _gameTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.isFinished) return;
      if (state.totalTimeLeft <= 1) {
        _finishGame();
      } else {
        emit(state.copyWith(totalTimeLeft: state.totalTimeLeft - 1));
      }
    });
  }
  void _startRound() {
    if (state.isFinished) return;
    if (state.round >= state.totalRounds) {
      _finishGame();
      return;
    }
    final card = _cards[state.round % _cards.length];
    final letters = card.word.split('')..shuffle();
    if (letters.join() == card.word) letters.shuffle();
    emit(
      state.copyWith(
        shuffledLetters: letters,
        targetWord: card.word,
        promptWord: card.translation,
        playerAnswer: [],
      ),
    );
  }
  void addLetter(String letter) {
    if (state.shuffledLetters.contains(letter)) {
      final newShuffled = List<String>.from(state.shuffledLetters)
        ..remove(letter);
      final newAnswer = List<String>.from(state.playerAnswer)..add(letter);
      emit(
        state.copyWith(playerAnswer: newAnswer, shuffledLetters: newShuffled),
      );
      if (newAnswer.join() == state.targetWord) {
        _playerSolved();
      }
    }
  }
  void removeLetter(int index) {
    final letter = state.playerAnswer[index];
    final newAnswer = List<String>.from(state.playerAnswer)..removeAt(index);
    final newShuffled = List<String>.from(state.shuffledLetters)..add(letter);
    emit(state.copyWith(playerAnswer: newAnswer, shuffledLetters: newShuffled));
  }
  void skipRound() {
    if (state.isFinished) return;
    emit(state.copyWith(round: state.round + 1));
    _startRound();
  }
  void _playerSolved() {
    final roundScore = 50 + state.totalTimeLeft;
    emit(
      state.copyWith(
        playerScore: state.playerScore + roundScore,
        round: state.round + 1,
      ),
    );
    _startRound();
  }
  Future<void> _finishGame() async {
    if (state.isFinished) return;
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    final totalTime = DateTime.now().difference(_sessionStartTime!).inSeconds;
    final accuracy = state.totalRounds > 0
        ? ((state.round / state.totalRounds) * 100).toInt()
        : 0;
    final serverUserId = await _repository.database.getServerUserId(email);
    if (serverUserId != null) {
      await _repository.saveGameResult(
        userId: serverUserId,
        gameType: 'word_duel',
        result: 'completed',
        score: state.playerScore,
        timeTakenSeconds: totalTime,
        accuracyPercent: accuracy,
      );
    }
    emit(state.copyWith(isFinished: true));
  }
  @override
  Future<void> close() {
    _gameTimer?.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/presentation/screens/games_menu_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/logic/games_menu_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/screens/word_duel_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/screens/sprint_pairs_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/widgets/leaderboard_widget.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' show DeckWithCount;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart';
enum GameType { wordDuel, sprintPairs }
class GamesMenuScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const GamesMenuScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
    if (email == null) return const Center(child: Text('Вы не авторизованы'));
    return BlocProvider(
      create: (_) =>
          GamesMenuCubit(context.read<GameRepository>())..loadStats(email),
      child: BlocBuilder<GamesMenuCubit, GamesMenuState>(
        builder: (context, state) {
          return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Игры')),
            body: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  if (state.userRank != null) _buildRankCard(state.userRank!),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  GridView.count(
                    shrinkWrap: true,
                    crossAxisCount: 2,
                    mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                    crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                    children: [
                      _GameCard(
                        title: 'Словесная дуэль',
                        icon: Icons.abc,
                        color: Colors.deepPurple,
                        onTap: () => _startGame(context, GameType.wordDuel),
                      ),
                      _GameCard(
                        title: 'Спринт-пары',
                        icon: Icons.compare_arrows,
                        color: Colors.teal,
                        onTap: () => _startGame(context, GameType.sprintPairs),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  const LeaderboardWidget(),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
  Future<void> _startGame(BuildContext context, GameType type) async {
    final repo = context.read<GameRepository>();
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser!.email!;
    final serverUserId = await repo.database.getServerUserId(email);
    if (serverUserId == null) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Профиль не найден')));
      }
      return;
    }
    final decks = await repo.getDecksForUser(serverUserId);
    if (decks.isEmpty) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('У вас нет колод')));
      }
      return;
    }
    final selectedDeck = await showDialog<DeckWithCount>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => SimpleDialog(
        title: const Text('Выберите колоду'),
        children: decks
            .map(
              (d) => SimpleDialogOption(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, d),
                child: Text('${d.deck.title} (карточек: ${d.cardCount})'),
              ),
            )
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
    if (selectedDeck == null) return;
    Widget gameScreen;
    if (type == GameType.wordDuel) {
      gameScreen = WordDuelScreen(deckId: selectedDeck.deck.id);
    } else {
      gameScreen = SprintPairsScreen(deckId: selectedDeck.deck.id);
    }
    final result = await Navigator.push<bool>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => gameScreen),
    );
    if (result == true && context.mounted) {
      context.read<GamesMenuCubit>().loadStats(email);
      context.read<ProfileCubit>().loadProfile();
    }
  }
  Widget _buildRankCard(UserRank rank) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Text(
              rank.rankName,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            LinearProgressIndicator(value: rank.progress),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text('${rank.experience} / ${rank.experienceToNextRank} XP'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
class _GameCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color color;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  const _GameCard({
    required this.title,
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
    required this.onTap,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 6,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 48, color: color),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                title,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  fontSize: 16,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/presentation/screens/sprint_pairs_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/logic/sprint_pairs_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/widgets/pairs_board.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
class SprintPairsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final String deckId;
  const SprintPairsScreen({super.key, required this.deckId});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
    if (email == null) return const Center(child: Text('Ошибка авторизации'));
    return FutureBuilder<List<db.Card>>(
      future: _fetchCardsFromDeck(context, deckId),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (!snapshot.hasData)
          return const Scaffold(
            body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
          );
        final cards = snapshot.data!;
        if (cards.length < 4) {
          return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Спринт-пары')),
            body: const Center(child: Text('Недостаточно карточек')),
          );
        }
        return BlocProvider(
          create: (_) =>
              SprintPairsCubit(context.read<GameRepository>(), email, cards),
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Спринт-пары')),
            body: BlocBuilder<SprintPairsCubit, SprintPairsState>(
              builder: (context, state) {
                if (state.isFinished) {
                  WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                    Navigator.pop(context, true);
                  });
                  return Center(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        const Icon(
                          Icons.emoji_events,
                          size: 80,
                          color: Colors.orange,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        Text(
                          'Игра окончена!',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 28,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text('Ваш счёт: ${state.playerScore}'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 24),
                        ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
                          child: const Text('В меню игр'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                }
                return PairsBoard(state: state);
              },
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
  Future<List<db.Card>> _fetchCardsFromDeck(
    BuildContext context,
    String deckId,
  ) async {
    final db = context.read<AppDatabase>();
    final query = db.select(db.cards)
      ..where((t) => t.deckId.equals(deckId))
      ..where((t) => t.isDeleted.equals(false));
    final cards = await query.get();
    if (cards.isEmpty) return [];
    cards.shuffle();
    return cards.take(8).toList();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/presentation/screens/word_duel_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as db;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/logic/word_duel_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/widgets/duel_board.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
class WordDuelScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final String deckId;
  const WordDuelScreen({super.key, required this.deckId});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
    if (email == null) return const Center(child: Text('Ошибка авторизации'));
    return FutureBuilder<List<db.Card>>(
      future: _fetchCardsFromDeck(context, deckId),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (!snapshot.hasData)
          return const Scaffold(
            body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
          );
        final cards = snapshot.data!;
        if (cards.length < 3) {
          return Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Словесная дуэль')),
            body: const Center(child: Text('Недостаточно карточек для игры')),
          );
        }
        return BlocProvider(
          create: (_) => WordDuelCubit(
            context.read<GameRepository>(),
            email,
            cards,
          ),
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Словесная дуэль')),
            body: BlocBuilder<WordDuelCubit, WordDuelState>(
              builder: (context, state) {
                if (state.isFinished) {
                  WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                    Navigator.pop(context, true);
                  });
                  return Center(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        const Icon(Icons.emoji_events,
                            size: 80, color: Colors.orange),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        Text('Игра окончена!',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 28, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text('Ваш счёт: ${state.playerScore}'),
                        const SizedBox(height: 24),
                        ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
                          child: const Text('В меню игр'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                }
                return DuelBoard(state: state);
              },
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
  Future<List<db.Card>> _fetchCardsFromDeck(BuildContext context, String deckId) async {
    final db = context.read<AppDatabase>();
    final query = db.select(db.cards)
  ..where((t) => t.deckId.equals(deckId))
  ..where((t) => t.isDeleted.equals(false));
    final cards = await query.get();
    if (cards.isEmpty) return [];
    cards.shuffle();
    return cards.take(7).toList();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/presentation/widgets/duel_board.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/logic/word_duel_cubit.dart';
class DuelBoard extends StatelessWidget {
  final WordDuelState state;
  const DuelBoard({super.key, required this.state});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: state.round / state.totalRounds,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
                  valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.green),
                  minHeight: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Text('${state.totalTimeLeft} сек',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('Счёт: ${state.playerScore}'),
              Text('Раунд ${state.round + 1}/${state.totalRounds}'),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text(
            state.promptWord,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 36, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            children: List.generate(state.playerAnswer.length, (index) {
              return GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => context.read<WordDuelCubit>().removeLetter(index),
                child: Chip(
                  label: Text(state.playerAnswer[index],
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
                  backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100,
                  deleteIcon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18),
                ),
              );
            }),
          ),
          const Divider(height: 32),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: state.shuffledLetters.map((letter) {
              return GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => context.read<WordDuelCubit>().addLetter(letter),
                child: Container(
                  width: 48,
                  height: 48,
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.blue.shade50,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    letter,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => context.read<WordDuelCubit>().skipRound(),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.skip_next),
            label: const Text('Пропустить'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size(double.infinity, 48),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```
