## `lib/features/games/presentation/widgets/leaderboard_widget.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
class LeaderboardWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const LeaderboardWidget({super.key});
  @override
  State<LeaderboardWidget> createState() => _LeaderboardWidgetState();
}
class _LeaderboardWidgetState extends State<LeaderboardWidget> {
  late Future<List<UserRank>> _leaderboardFuture;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadLeaderboard();
  }
  void _loadLeaderboard() {
    _leaderboardFuture = context.read<GameRepository>().getLeaderboard();
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Таблица лидеров',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                  onPressed: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _loadLeaderboard();
                    });
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FutureBuilder<List<UserRank>>(
              future: _leaderboardFuture,
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return _buildErrorState();
                }
                final users = snapshot.data ?? [];
                if (users.isEmpty) {
                  return const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
                    child: Text(
                      'Пока нет данных. Сыграйте в игры!',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  );
                }
                return ListView.separated(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  itemCount: users.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const Divider(),
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final user = users[index];
                    return ListTile(
                      leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${index + 1}')),
                      title: Text(user.email),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        '${user.rankName} • ${user.experience} XP',
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildErrorState() {
    return Column(
      children: [
        const Text('Ошибка загрузки'),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: () {
            setState(() {
              _loadLeaderboard();
            });
          },
          child: const Text('Повторить'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/games/presentation/widgets/pairs_board.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/logic/sprint_pairs_cubit.dart';
class PairsBoard extends StatelessWidget {
  final SprintPairsState state;
  const PairsBoard({super.key, required this.state});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cubit = context.read<SprintPairsCubit>();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12.0),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: state.pairsFound / state.totalPairs,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
                  valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.green),
                  minHeight: 14,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Text('${state.totalTimeLeft} сек',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text('Счёт: ${state.playerScore}'),
              Text('Найдено пар: ${state.pairsFound}/${state.totalPairs}'),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: ListView(
                    children: state.shuffledLeft.map((pair) {
                      final isSelected = state.selectedLeftId == pair.cardId;
                      return GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => cubit.selectLeft(pair.cardId),
                        child: Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: isSelected
                                ? Colors.green.shade100
                                : Colors.blue.shade50,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: isSelected
                                ? Border.all(color: Colors.green, width: 2)
                                : null,
                          ),
                          child: Text(pair.word,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 18,
                                fontWeight: isSelected
                                    ? FontWeight.bold
                                    : FontWeight.normal,
                              ),
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                Expanded(
                  child: ListView(
                    children: state.shuffledRight.map((pair) {
                      final isSelected = state.selectedRightId == pair.cardId;
                      return GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => cubit.selectRight(pair.cardId),
                        child: Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: isSelected
                                ? Colors.green.shade100
                                : Colors.orange.shade50,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: isSelected
                                ? Border.all(color: Colors.green, width: 2)
                                : null,
                          ),
                          child: Text(pair.translation,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 18,
                                fontWeight: isSelected
                                    ? FontWeight.bold
                                    : FontWeight.normal,
                              ),
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/home/presentation/screens/main_wrapper.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/screens/games_menu_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/home/presentation/widgets/decks_view.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/presentation/screens/profile_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/settings/presentation/settings_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/sync/sync_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/network_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/notifications/notification_service.dart';
class MainWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<MainWrapper> createState() => _MainWrapperState();
}
class _MainWrapperState extends State<MainWrapper> {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  final List<Widget> _pages = [
    const Center(child: DecksView()),
    const GamesMenuScreen(),
    const Center(child: ProfileScreen()),
    SettingsScreen(),
  ];
  final List<String> _titles = ["Мои колоды", "Игры", "Профиль", "Настройки"];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final db = context.read<AppDatabase>();
      NotificationService().scheduleWordOfTheDay(db);
    });
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BlocListener<NetworkCubit, NetworkState>(
      listener: (context, state) {
        if (state == NetworkState.offline) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.wifi_off, color: Colors.white),
                  SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Text('Нет подключения к интернету'),
                ],
              ),
              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
              duration: Duration(days: 1),
            ),
          );
        } else if (state == NetworkState.online) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).hideCurrentSnackBar();
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(
              content: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.wifi, color: Colors.white),
                  SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Text('Подключение восстановлено'),
                ],
              ),
              backgroundColor: Colors.green,
              duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
            ),
          );
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(_titles[_currentIndex]),
          centerTitle: true,
          actions: [
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.sync),
              tooltip: 'Синхронизировать данные',
              onPressed: () async {
                print("🔘 Нажата кнопка синхронизации!");
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  const SnackBar(
                    content: Text('🔄 Синхронизация с сервером...'),
                  ),
                );
                try {
                  final db = context.read<AppDatabase>();
                  final apiClient = ApiClient();
                  final syncService = SyncService(db, apiClient);
                  final firebaseUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
                  if (firebaseUser != null && firebaseUser.email != null) {
                    final serverId = await db.getServerUserId(
                      firebaseUser.email!,
                    );
                    print("🔍 ID для синхронизации: $serverId");
                    if (serverId != null) {
                      await syncService.pushDirtyData();
                      await syncService.pullServerData(serverId);
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(
                            content: Text('✅ Синхронизация завершена!'),
                          ),
                        );
                        context.read<ProfileCubit>().loadProfile();
                      }
                    } else {
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(
                            content: Text(
                              '❌ Ошибка: Локальный профиль не найден.',
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                    }
                  }
                } catch (e) {
                  print("❌ Ошибка при синхронизации: $e");
                  if (context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).hideCurrentSnackBar();
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text(
                          '❌ Нет связи с сервером. Проверьте интернет.',
                        ),
                        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                }
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
        body: _pages[_currentIndex],
        bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 10),
            height: 70,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
              boxShadow: const [
                BoxShadow(color: Colors.black26, blurRadius: 10),
              ],
            ),
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
              child: BottomNavigationBar(
                currentIndex: _currentIndex,
                onTap: (index) {
                  if (index == 2) {
                    context.read<ProfileCubit>().loadProfile();
                  }
                  setState(() => _currentIndex = index);
                },
                type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,
                showSelectedLabels: false,
                showUnselectedLabels: false,
                items: const [
                  BottomNavigationBarItem(
                    icon: Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
                    label: "",
                  ),
                  BottomNavigationBarItem(
                    icon: Icon(Icons.videogame_asset_rounded),
                    label: "",
                  ),
                  BottomNavigationBarItem(
                    icon: Icon(Icons.person_rounded),
                    label: "",
                  ),
                  BottomNavigationBarItem(
                    icon: Icon(Icons.settings_rounded),
                    label: "",
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/decks_view.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' hide Card;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/cards/presentation/screens/training_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/logic/deck_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/decks/presentation/screens/manage_deck_screen.dart';
import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
class DecksView extends StatelessWidget {
  const DecksView({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    return Scaffold(
      body: BlocBuilder<DeckCubit, List<DeckWithCount>>(
        builder: (context, items) {
          if (items.isEmpty) {
            return Center(child: Text(l10n.decks_view_no_decks));
          }
          return GridView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 2,
              crossAxisSpacing: 16,
              mainAxisSpacing: 16,
            ),
            itemCount: items.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final deck = items[index];
              return _DeckCard(item: deck);
            },
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _showAddDeckDialog(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showAddDeckDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = TextEditingController();
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_add_deck_dialog_new_deck),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: l10n.decks_view__show_add_deck_dialog_hint_title,
              ),
              autofocus: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            const Divider(),
            TextButton.icon(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.download),
              label: const Text("Или импортировать по коду"),
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                _showImportDialog(context);
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_add_deck_dialog_cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              if (controller.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                context.read<DeckCubit>().addDeck(controller.text.trim(), null);
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              }
            },
            child: Text(l10n.decks_view__show_add_deck_dialog_create),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showImportDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final codeController = TextEditingController();
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text("Импорт колоды"),
        content: TextField(
          controller: codeController,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            hintText: "Вставьте код колоды (например: ID_ID)",
          ),
          autofocus: true,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: const Text("Отмена"),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () async {
              final code = codeController.text.trim();
              if (code.isNotEmpty) {
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                try {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(content: Text('📥 Идет скачивание...')),
                  );
                  await context.read<DeckCubit>().importDeckByCode(code);
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(
                      content: Text('✅ Колода успешно импортирована!'),
                    ),
                  );
                } catch (e) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(
                      content: Text('❌ Ошибка: $e'),
                      backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              }
            },
            child: const Text("Импортировать"),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
class _DeckCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final DeckWithCount item;
  const _DeckCard({required this.item});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Card(
      elevation: 4,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          InkWell(
            onTap: () {
              if (item.cardCount > 0) {
                Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                    builder: (context) => TrainingScreen(deckId: item.deck.id),
                  ),
                );
              } else {
                Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                    builder: (context) => ManageDeckScreen(deck: item.deck),
                  ),
                );
              }
            },
            onLongPress: () => _showActionMenu(context, item.deck),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12.0),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.folder_open, size: 40, color: Colors.blue),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    item.deck.title,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    "Карточек: ${item.cardCount}",
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            top: 4,
            right: 4,
            child: IconButton(
              onPressed: () => _showActionMenu(context, item.deck),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.more_vert, size: 20),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showActionMenu(BuildContext context, Deck deck) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (bottomSheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.edit),
              title: Text(l10n.deck_card__show_action_menu_edit_title),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(bottomSheetContext);
                Navigator.push(
                  context,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                    builder: (_) => ManageDeckScreen(deck: deck),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.share, color: Colors.blue),
              title: const Text("Поделиться колодой"),
              onTap: () async {
                Navigator.pop(bottomSheetContext);
                final db = context.read<AppDatabase>();
                final email = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email;
                if (email != null) {
                  final serverId = await db.getServerUserId(email);
                  if (serverId != null) {
                    final shareCode = "${serverId}_${deck.id}";
                    Share.share(
                      'Я создал классную колоду "${deck.title}"! \nСкачай её себе в MemoLingvo, используя этот код импорта:\n\n$shareCode',
                    );
                  }
                }
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
              title: Text(
                l10n.deck_card__show_action_menu_delete_deck,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
              ),
              onTap: () {
                context.read<DeckCubit>().deleteDeck(deck.id);
                Navigator.pop(bottomSheetContext);
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/data/repositories/profile_repository.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/domain/entities/user_profile.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
class ProfileRepository {
  final AppDatabase _db;
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  ProfileRepository(this._db, this._prefs);
  Future<UserProfile?> getLocalProfile(String email) async {
    final userData = await (_db.select(
      _db.usersTable,
    )..where((t) => t.email.equals(email))).getSingleOrNull();
    if (userData == null) return null;
    return UserProfile(
      id: userData.id,
      email: userData.email,
      createdAt: userData.createdAt,
    );
  }
  Future<Map<String, int>> getLearningStats(String userId) async {
    final totalCardsQuery = _db.select(_db.cards).join([
      innerJoin(_db.decks, _db.decks.id.equalsExp(_db.cards.deckId)),
    ]);
    totalCardsQuery.where(_db.decks.userId.equals(userId));
    totalCardsQuery.where(_db.cards.isDeleted.equals(false));
    final totalCardsRows = await totalCardsQuery.get();
    final totalCards = totalCardsRows.length;
    final progressList = await (_db.select(
      _db.cardProgress,
    )..where((t) => t.userId.equals(userId))).get();
    final activeCardIds = totalCardsRows
        .map((r) => r.readTable(_db.cards).id)
        .toSet();
    final activeProgress = progressList
        .where((p) => activeCardIds.contains(p.cardId))
        .toList();
    int mastered = activeProgress.where((p) => p.repetitions >= 5).length;
    int learning = activeProgress
        .where((p) => p.repetitions > 0 && p.repetitions < 5)
        .length;
    int newCards = totalCards - (mastered + learning);
    return {
      'total': totalCards,
      'mastered': mastered,
      'learning': learning,
      'new': newCards,
    };
  }
  String? getAvatarPath() {
    return _prefs.getString('avatar_path');
  }
  Future<void> saveAvatarPath(String? path) async {
    if (path == null) {
      await _prefs.remove('avatar_path');
    } else {
      await _prefs.setString('avatar_path', path);
    }
  }
  Future<bool> updateAvatarFromFile(File imageFile) async {
    try {
      final appDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
      final avatarsDir = Directory('${appDir.path}/avatars');
      if (!await avatarsDir.exists()) {
        await avatarsDir.create(recursive: true);
      }
      final fileName = '${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.png';
      final newPath = '${avatarsDir.path}/$fileName';
      await imageFile.copy(newPath);
      await saveAvatarPath(newPath);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      print('Ошибка сохранения аватара: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }
  Stream<List<({Card card, CardProgressData progress})>>
  watchLearnedCardsWithProgress(String userId) {
    final query =
        _db.select(_db.cards).join([
            innerJoin(
              _db.cardProgress,
              _db.cardProgress.cardId.equalsExp(_db.cards.id),
            ),
          ])
          ..where(
            _db.cardProgress.userId.equals(userId) &
                _db.cardProgress.repetitions.isBiggerOrEqualValue(5),
          )
          ..where(_db.cards.isDeleted.equals(false));
    return query.watch().map((rows) {
      return rows.map((row) {
        final card = row.readTable(_db.cards);
        final progress = row.readTable(_db.cardProgress);
        return (card: card, progress: progress);
      }).toList();
    });
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/domain/entities/user_profile.dart`

```dart
import 'package:equatable/equatable.dart';
class UserProfile extends Equatable {
  final String id;
  final String email;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final String? avatarUrl;
  final String? displayName;
  const UserProfile({
    required this.id,
    required this.email,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.avatarUrl,
    this.displayName,
  });
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [id, email, createdAt, avatarUrl, displayName];
  UserProfile copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? email,
    DateTime? createdAt,
    String? avatarUrl,
    String? displayName,
  }) {
    return UserProfile(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      email: email ?? this.email,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
      avatarUrl: avatarUrl ?? this.avatarUrl,
      displayName: displayName ?? this.displayName,
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/data/repositories/profile_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_state.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'dart:io';
class ProfileCubit extends Cubit<ProfileState> {
  final ProfileRepository _repository;
  final FirebaseAuth _auth;
  ProfileCubit(this._repository, this._auth) : super(ProfileInitial()) {
    loadProfile();
  }
  Future<void> loadProfile() async {
    emit(ProfileLoading());
    try {
      final user = _auth.currentUser;
      if (user == null || user.email == null) {
        emit(ProfileError('Пользователь не авторизован'));
        return;
      }
      final profile = await _repository.getLocalProfile(user.email!);
      if (profile == null) {
        emit(ProfileError('Профиль не найден'));
        return;
      }
      final stats = await _repository.getLearningStats(profile.id);
      final avatarPath = _repository.getAvatarPath();
      emit(ProfileLoaded(profile, stats, avatarPath));
    } catch (e) {
      emit(ProfileError(e.toString()));
    }
  }
  Future<void> updateAvatar(File imageFile) async {
    final state = this.state;
    if (state is! ProfileLoaded) return;
    final success = await _repository.updateAvatarFromFile(imageFile);
    if (success) {
      await loadProfile();
    } else {
      emit(ProfileError('Не удалось сохранить аватар'));
    }
  }
  Future<void> removeAvatar() async {
    final state = this.state;
    if (state is! ProfileLoaded) return;
    await _repository.saveAvatarPath(null);
    await loadProfile();
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/logic/profile_state.dart`

```dart
import 'package:equatable/equatable.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/domain/entities/user_profile.dart';
abstract class ProfileState extends Equatable {
  const ProfileState();
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [];
}
class ProfileInitial extends ProfileState {}
class ProfileLoading extends ProfileState {}
class ProfileLoaded extends ProfileState {
  final UserProfile profile;
  final Map<String, int> stats;
  final String? avatarPath;
  const ProfileLoaded(this.profile, this.stats, this.avatarPath);
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [profile, stats, avatarPath];
}
class ProfileError extends ProfileState {
  final String message;
  const ProfileError(this.message);
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [message];
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/presentation/screens/learned_words_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart' as dba;
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/data/repositories/profile_repository.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:fuzzy/fuzzy.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
class LearnedWordsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LearnedWordsScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<LearnedWordsScreen> createState() => _LearnedWordsScreenState();
}
class _LearnedWordsScreenState extends State<LearnedWordsScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  String _searchQuery = '';
  List<({dba.Card card, dba.CardProgressData progress})> _allItems = [];
  List<({dba.Card card, dba.CardProgressData progress})> _filteredItems = [];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadLearnedWords();
    _searchController.addListener(() {
      setState(() {
        _searchQuery = _searchController.text;
        _filterItems();
      });
    });
  }
  Future<void> _loadLearnedWords() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final db = context.read<dba.AppDatabase>();
    final repo = ProfileRepository(db, prefs);
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (user == null || user.email == null) return;
    final serverId = await db.getServerUserId(user.email!);
    if (serverId == null) return;
    final stream = repo.watchLearnedCardsWithProgress(serverId);
    stream.listen((items) {
      setState(() {
        _allItems = items;
        _filterItems();
      });
    });
  }
  void _filterItems() {
    if (_searchQuery.trim().isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _filteredItems = List.from(_allItems);
      });
    } else {
      final fuse = Fuzzy<({dba.Card card, dba.CardProgressData progress})>(
        _allItems,
        options: FuzzyOptions(
          findAllMatches: true,
          threshold: 0.4,
          keys: [
            WeightedKey(
              name: 'word',
              getter: (item) => item.card.word,
              weight: 1.0,
            ),
            WeightedKey(
              name: 'translation',
              getter: (item) => item.card.translation,
              weight: 0.8,
            ),
            WeightedKey(
              name: 'meaning',
              getter: (item) => item.card.meaning ?? '',
              weight: 0.5,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      final result = fuse.search(_searchQuery);
      setState(() {
        _filteredItems = result.map((r) => r.item).toList();
      });
    }
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Выученные слова'),
        bottom: PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(60),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
            child: TextField(
              controller: _searchController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Поиск слова, перевода или значения...',
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                ),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: _filteredItems.isEmpty
          ? const Center(child: Text('Нет выученных слов'))
          : ListView.builder(
              itemCount: _filteredItems.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final item = _filteredItems[index];
                final card = item.card;
                final progress = item.progress;
                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12,
                    vertical: 6,
                  ),
                  child: ListTile(
                    title: Text(
                      card.word,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                    ),
                    subtitle: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(card.translation),
                        if (card.meaning != null)
                          Text(
                            card.meaning!,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: Colors.grey,
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    trailing: Column(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          '${progress.repetitions} повт.',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'инт: ${progress.interval} дн.',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    onTap: () {
                      showDialog(
                        context: context,
                        builder: (_) => AlertDialog(
                          title: Text(card.word),
                          content: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text('Перевод: ${card.translation}'),
                              if (card.transcription != null)
                                Text('Транскрипция: [${card.transcription}]'),
                              if (card.meaning != null)
                                Text('Значение: ${card.meaning}'),
                              if (card.examples != null &&
                                  card.examples!.isNotEmpty)
                                Text('Примеры: ${card.examples!.join(', ')}'),
                              const Divider(),
                              Text('Повторений: ${progress.repetitions}'),
                              Text('Интервал: ${progress.interval} дней'),
                              Text(
                                'EF: ${progress.easinessFactor.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          actions: [
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                              child: const Text('Закрыть'),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/presentation/screens/profile_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_state.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/presentation/widgets/avatar_widget.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/presentation/screens/learned_words_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/data/repositories/game_repository.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/presentation/widgets/leaderboard_widget.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/games/domain/entities/user_rank.dart';
class ProfileScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Мой профиль')),
      body: BlocBuilder<ProfileCubit, ProfileState>(
        builder: (context, state) {
          if (state is ProfileLoading) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (state is ProfileError) {
            return Center(child: Text('Ошибка: ${state.message}'));
          }
          if (state is ProfileLoaded) {
            final profile = state.profile;
            final stats = state.stats;
            return SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  AvatarWidget(avatarPath: state.avatarPath, size: 100),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(profile.email, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 32),
                  _buildStatCard('Всего карточек', stats['total'] ?? 0),
                  _buildStatCard('Выучено', stats['mastered'] ?? 0),
                  _buildStatCard('В процессе', stats['learning'] ?? 0),
                  _buildStatCard('Новых', stats['new'] ?? 0),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                      context,
                      MaterialPageRoute(
                        builder: (_) => const LearnedWordsScreen(),
                      ),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.school),
                    label: const Text('Словарь выученных слов'),
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 32),
                  _GameStatsBlock(userId: profile.id),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  const LeaderboardWidget(),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        },
      ),
    );
  }
  Widget _buildStatCard(String title, int value) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
      child: ListTile(
        title: Text(title),
        trailing: Text(
          '$value',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
class _GameStatsBlock extends StatelessWidget {
  final String userId;
  const _GameStatsBlock({required this.userId});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final gameRepo = context.read<GameRepository>();
    return FutureBuilder<UserRank>(
      future: gameRepo.getUserRank(userId).then((value) => value!),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (!snapshot.hasData) return const SizedBox.shrink();
        final rank = snapshot.data!;
        return Card(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Игровой ранг',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      rank.rankName,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text(
                      '${rank.experience} XP',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: rank.progress,
                    minHeight: 8,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/profile/presentation/widgets/avatar_widget.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/profile/logic/profile_cubit.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
class AvatarWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final String? avatarPath;
  final double size;
  const AvatarWidget({super.key, this.avatarPath, this.size = 80});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _showPickerOptions(context),
      child: CircleAvatar(
        radius: size / 2,
        backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
        backgroundImage: avatarPath != null && File(avatarPath!).existsSync()
            ? FileImage(File(avatarPath!))
            : null,
        child: avatarPath == null
            ? Icon(Icons.person, size: size * 0.5, color: Colors.grey.shade400)
            : null,
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showPickerOptions(BuildContext context) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (bottomSheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
              child: Text(
                'Фото профиля',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt, color: Colors.blue),
              title: const Text('Сделать фото'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(bottomSheetContext).pop();
                _pickAndUpdateAvatar(context, ImageSource.camera);
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_library, color: Colors.blue),
              title: const Text('Выбрать из галереи'),
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.of(bottomSheetContext).pop();
                _pickAndUpdateAvatar(context, ImageSource.gallery);
              },
            ),
            if (avatarPath != null)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                title: const Text(
                  'Удалить фото',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                ),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(bottomSheetContext).pop();
                  context.read<ProfileCubit>().removeAvatar();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Future<void> _pickAndUpdateAvatar(
    BuildContext context,
    ImageSource source,
  ) async {
    final picker = ImagePicker();
    try {
      final pickedFile = await picker.pickImage(
        source: source,
        imageQuality: 70,
        maxWidth: 800,
      );
      if (pickedFile != null && context.mounted) {
        final file = File(pickedFile.path);
        await context.read<ProfileCubit>().updateAvatar(file);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Ошибка при выборе фото: $e')));
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/settings/presentation/settings_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/locale_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/logic/auth_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/theme/theme_cubit.dart';
class SettingsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    final currentLocale = context.watch<LocaleCubit>().state;
    String getCurrentLanguageName() {
      switch (currentLocale.languageCode) {
        case 'en':
          return 'English';
        case 'ru':
          return 'Русский';
        default:
          return 'Русский';
      }
    }
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(l10n.settings_screen_title)),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(Icons.language),
            title: Text(l10n.settings_screen_change_language),
            trailing: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  getCurrentLanguageName(),
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                ),
                const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios, size: 16),
              ],
            ),
            onTap: () => _showLanguagePicker(context),
          ),
          BlocBuilder<ThemeCubit, ThemeMode>(
            builder: (context, mode) {
              return SwitchListTile(
                secondary: const Icon(Icons.dark_mode),
                title: Text(l10n.settings_screen_dark_mode),
                value: mode == ThemeMode.dark,
                onChanged: (bool value) {
                  context.read<ThemeCubit>().toggleTheme(value);
                },
              );
            },
          ),
          const Divider(),
          ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(Icons.logout, color: Colors.red),
            title: Text(
              l10n.settings_screen_logout,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
            ),
            onTap: () {
              context.read<AuthCubit>().logout();
              Navigator.of(
                context,
              ).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil('/welcome', (route) => false);
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showLanguagePicker(BuildContext context) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          ListTile(
            title: const Text("Русский"),
            onTap: () {
              context.read<LocaleCubit>().setLocale('ru');
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
          ),
          ListTile(
            title: const Text("English"),
            onTap: () {
              context.read<LocaleCubit>().setLocale('en');
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## `lib/features/sync/sync_service.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/api_client.dart';
import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
class SyncService {
  final AppDatabase _db;
  final ApiClient _api;
  SyncService(this._db, this._api);
  Future<void> pushDirtyData() async {
    print("🚀 Начинаю синхронизацию (Push)...");
    await _syncDecks();
    await _syncCards();
    await _syncProgress();
    print("✅ Синхронизация завершена!");
  }
  /*Future<void> _syncUser() async {
    final users = await _db.select(_db.usersTable).get();
    if (users.isEmpty) return;
    final currentUser = users.first;
    final data = {
      'userID': currentUser.id,
      'email': currentUser.email,
      'passwordHash': 'FirebaseAuth', 
      'createdAt': currentUser.createdAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    };
    await _api.pushUser(data);
  }*/
  Future<void> _syncDecks() async {
    final dirtyDecks = await (_db.select(
      _db.decks,
    )..where((t) => t.isDirty.equals(true))).get();
    if (dirtyDecks.isEmpty) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> payload = dirtyDecks
        .map(
          (deck) => {
            'deckID': deck.id,
            'userID': deck.userId,
            'title': deck.title,
            'description': deck.description,
            'updateAt': deck.updateAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
            'isDeleted': deck.isDeleted,
          },
        )
        .toList();
    final success = await _api.pushDeck(payload);
    if (success) {
      for (final deck in dirtyDecks) {
        await (_db.update(_db.decks)..where((t) => t.id.equals(deck.id))).write(
          const DecksCompanion(isDirty: Value(false)),
        );
      }
    }
  }
  Future<void> _syncCards() async {
    final dirtyCards = await (_db.select(
      _db.cards,
    )..where((t) => t.isDirty.equals(true))).get();
    if (dirtyCards.isEmpty) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> payload = dirtyCards
        .map(
          (card) => {
            'cardID': card.id,
            'deckID': card.deckId,
            'word': card.word,
            'translation': card.translation,
            'transcription': card.transcription,
            'meaning': card.meaning,
            'examples': card.examples != null
                ? jsonEncode(card.examples)
                : null,
            'updateAt': card.updateAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
            'isDeleted': card.isDeleted,
          },
        )
        .toList();
    final success = await _api.pushCard(payload);
    if (success) {
      for (final card in dirtyCards) {
        await (_db.update(_db.cards)..where((t) => t.id.equals(card.id))).write(
          const CardsCompanion(isDirty: Value(false)),
        );
      }
    }
  }
  Future<void> _syncProgress() async {
    final dirtyProgress = await (_db.select(
      _db.cardProgress,
    )..where((t) => t.isDirty.equals(true))).get();
    if (dirtyProgress.isEmpty) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> payload = dirtyProgress
        .map(
          (progress) => {
            'cardID': progress.cardId,
            'userID': progress.userId,
            'nextReview': progress.nextReview.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
            'easinessFactor': progress.easinessFactor,
            'repetitions': progress.repetitions,
            'interval': progress.interval,
            'updateAt': progress.updateAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
          },
        )
        .toList();
    final success = await _api.pushProgress(payload);
    if (success) {
      for (final progress in dirtyProgress) {
        await (_db.update(_db.cardProgress)..where(
              (t) =>
                  t.cardId.equals(progress.cardId) &
                  t.userId.equals(progress.userId),
            ))
            .write(const CardProgressCompanion(isDirty: Value(false)));
      }
    }
  }
  Future<void> pullServerData(String currentUserId) async {
    print("📥 Начинаю скачивание данных с сервера (Pull)...");
    final serverDecks = await _api.getDecks(currentUserId);
    for (var deckMap in serverDecks) {
      final String serverId = deckMap['deckID'];
      final DateTime serverUpdateAt = DateTime.parse(
        deckMap['updateAt'],
      ).toUtc();
      final localDeck = await (_db.select(
        _db.decks,
      )..where((t) => t.id.equals(serverId))).getSingleOrNull();
      if (localDeck == null || serverUpdateAt.isAfter(localDeck.updateAt)) {
        await _db
            .into(_db.decks)
            .insertOnConflictUpdate(
              DecksCompanion.insert(
                id: serverId,
                userId: deckMap['userID'],
                title: deckMap['title'],
                description: deckMap['description'] != null
                    ? Value(deckMap['description'])
                    : const Value.absent(),
                updateAt: serverUpdateAt,
                isDeleted: Value(deckMap['isDeleted'] ?? false),
                isDirty: const Value(false),
              ),
            );
      }
    }
    final serverCards = await _api.getCards(currentUserId);
    for (var cardMap in serverCards) {
      final String serverId = cardMap['cardID'];
      final DateTime serverUpdateAt = DateTime.parse(
        cardMap['updateAt'],
      ).toUtc();
      final localCard = await (_db.select(
        _db.cards,
      )..where((t) => t.id.equals(serverId))).getSingleOrNull();
      if (localCard == null || serverUpdateAt.isAfter(localCard.updateAt)) {
        List<String>? parsedExamples;
        if (cardMap['examples'] != null &&
            cardMap['examples'].toString().isNotEmpty) {
          try {
            parsedExamples = List<String>.from(jsonDecode(cardMap['examples']));
          } catch (e) {
            print(
              "⚠️ Ошибка парсинга examples (пришел мусор с сервера). Игнорируем.",
            );
            parsedExamples = [];
          }
        }
        await _db
            .into(_db.cards)
            .insertOnConflictUpdate(
              CardsCompanion.insert(
                id: serverId,
                deckId: cardMap['deckID'],
                word: cardMap['word'],
                translation: cardMap['translation'],
                transcription: cardMap['transcription'] != null
                    ? Value(cardMap['transcription'])
                    : const Value.absent(),
                meaning: cardMap['meaning'],
                examples: parsedExamples != null
                    ? Value(parsedExamples)
                    : const Value.absent(),
                updateAt: serverUpdateAt,
                isDeleted: Value(cardMap['isDeleted'] ?? false),
                isDirty: const Value(false),
              ),
            );
      }
    }
    final serverProgressList = await _api.getProgress(currentUserId);
    for (var progressMap in serverProgressList) {
      final String serverCardId = progressMap['cardID'];
      final String serverUserId = progressMap['userID'];
      final DateTime serverUpdateAt = DateTime.parse(
        progressMap['updateAt'],
      ).toUtc();
      final localProgress =
          await (_db.select(_db.cardProgress)..where(
                (t) =>
                    t.cardId.equals(serverCardId) &
                    t.userId.equals(serverUserId),
              ))
              .getSingleOrNull();
      if (localProgress == null ||
          serverUpdateAt.isAfter(localProgress.updateAt)) {
        await _db
            .into(_db.cardProgress)
            .insertOnConflictUpdate(
              CardProgressCompanion.insert(
                cardId: serverCardId,
                userId: serverUserId,
                nextReview: DateTime.parse(progressMap['nextReview']).toUtc(),
                easinessFactor: Value(
                  (progressMap['easinessFactor'] as num).toDouble(),
                ),
                repetitions: Value((progressMap['repetitions'] as num).toInt()),
                interval: Value((progressMap['interval'] as num).toInt()),
                updateAt: serverUpdateAt,
                isDirty: const Value(false),
              ),
            );
      }
    }
    print("✅ Скачивание завершено!");
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart' show FirebaseOptions;
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart'
    show defaultTargetPlatform, kIsWeb, TargetPlatform;
class DefaultFirebaseOptions {
  static FirebaseOptions get currentPlatform {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      return web;
    }
    switch (defaultTargetPlatform) {
      case TargetPlatform.android:
        return android;
      case TargetPlatform.iOS:
        return ios;
      case TargetPlatform.macOS:
        return macos;
      case TargetPlatform.windows:
        return windows;
      case TargetPlatform.linux:
        throw UnsupportedError(
          'DefaultFirebaseOptions have not been configured for linux - '
          'you can reconfigure this by running the FlutterFire CLI again.',
        );
      default:
        throw UnsupportedError(
          'DefaultFirebaseOptions are not supported for this platform.',
        );
    }
  }
```

## `lib/main.dart`

```dart
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/app_providers.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/localization/locale_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/notifications/notification_service.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/theme/theme_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/login_sreen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/register_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/auth/presentation/screens/welcome_screen.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/features/home/presentation/screens/main_wrapper.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/firebase_options.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/network/network_cubit.dart';
import 'package:memo_lingvo/core/notifications/notification_service.dart';
class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final locale = context.watch<LocaleCubit>().state;
    final themeMode = context.watch<ThemeCubit>().state;
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'MemoLingvo',
      locale: locale,
      themeMode: themeMode,
      theme: ThemeData.light(),
      darkTheme: ThemeData.dark(),
      localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ru')],
      initialRoute: '/',
      routes: {
        '/': (context) => SplashScreen(),
        '/login': (context) => LoginScreen(),
        '/register': (context) => RegisterScreen(),
        '/welcome': (context) => WelcomeScreen(),
        '/home': (context) => MainWrapper(),
      },
    );
  }
}
void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);
  await NotificationService().init();
  final database = AppDatabase();
  final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  runApp(AppProviders(child: MyApp(), database: database, prefs: prefs));
}
```

## `README.md`

```markdown
# MemoLingvo
## Getting Started
Flutter project for learning English language by interactive cards.
```
